posts.title: “Flowers on Trip (旅途的花样)” - Travel Reality Show
posts.text: 2017, Hua Chenyu joined the “Flowers on Trip (旅途的花样)” show. It’s a travel reality show. They would travel In Morocco, Russia, Norway, and Denmark, take everyone to experience the real exotic culture, and at the same time bring Chinese culture to every country on the journey. 1. About the show“Flowers on Trip” is a program in which a regular cast of seven celebrities travels to Morocco, Russia, Norway, and Denmark to bring Chinese culture to other countries while giving the audience a real cross-cultural experience.The seven celebrities are Hua Chenyu, Aarif Lee Rahman, Shen Teng, Lin Chi-ling, Gina Jin, Zhang Xinyi (Er-jie) and Ma Li. Through this show, Hua developed a deep friendship with Zhang Xinyi. And Zhang Xinyi went to see Hua’s “Mars Concert 2018“. Hua also collaborated with Shen Teng, whom he met on this show, again on the Variety Show “Ace VS Ace“. 2. PlaylistFull Version of “Flowers on Trip”https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3RgL6OzNqiip7Wjwxu68kIXPM_t2XMaF “Hua Chenyu’s Travel Diary”The program team released Hua Chenyu’s personal clips under the title “Hua Chenyu’s Travel Diary (华晨宇的旅行日记)”: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPnZ9a-pAH-ex3BxsFgti2cDXIccQD8dn 3. Detailed information about each episodeEP1 Divided into two groups and depart for MoroccoJune 3, 2017Location: Morocco, The Labyrinth of Fez Whiskers Hua (须须), a member of HCY148, rode a cute pony on the beach by the sea.Hua happened to meet an elderly Chinese couple on the train and helped them find a seat.But by the time he walked this elderly couple to the platform and took a souvenir photo with them, the train had already departed. Hua Chenyu, who had all his luggage and money on the train, found out that he could board the next train for free after communicating with the station staff. EP2 Adventure in the Sahara DesertJune 10, 2017Location: The Labyrinth of Fez, Sahara Desert They encountered a very dangerous black storm in the Sahara Desert and lost contact with the base.It’s cool to see Hua enjoying sandboarding! EP3 Performance at a local festivalJune 17, 2017Location: Morocco Famous scene of HCY148 member Jiu Jiu (揪揪)! The watermelon that Hua had been holding for several kilometers fell to the ground and broke just as he was about to pose for a photo.Hua Chenyu and Gina Jin crouched down on the ground, picked up the part of the watermelon that wasn’t touching the ground, and ate it.At a local festival, seven of them performed the song and dance “A Fire in Winter (冬天里的一把火)” (the Chinese version of “Sexy Music”). EP4 Handmade gifts to Chinese medical teamJune 24, 2017Location: Morocco Hua helped Shen Teng move and deliver a stone sculpture of an ape that was as tall as a person.After going through a lot of effort to transport the stone sculpture back to China, Shen Teng discovered that it was “Made in China”.seven of them went to visit the Chinese medical team and gave them handmade gifts.Because Hua looked so young, the flight attendant had to see his passport before she dared to give him alcohol. EP5 Experience astronaut’s zero-gravity trainingJuly 8, 2017Location: Moscow Hua has always liked jeans with holes in the knees, but when he learned to wrestle, the holes became bigger because of the excessive range of movements.So this pair of ripped jeans became Hua’s favorite.Experienced the zero-gravity training of astronauts. EP6 From Whiskers Hua (须须) to Shell-head Brother (壳哥).July 15, 2017Location: Moscow Zhang Xinyi and Lin Chi-ling cut Hua’s hair into a pot head with flush edges like an eggshell!Have fun with the cat circus. EP7 16th century lifestyleJuly 22, 2017Location: Suzdal Took care of Jin Chen who fell off her horse and hit her head.Hua sold fried rice at a food stall and had a live performance on the street with Aarif Lee. EP8 Pushkin House and Ice HockeyJuly 29, 2017Location: Saint Petersburg Deep resonance with the writer Pushkin.Learned ice hockey. EP9 Fantastic VoyageAugust 5, 2017Location: Norway Search for Trolls in the Norwegian forests.Seeing a taciturn child reminded Hua of himself as a child. So he played guitar for the kid.The hotel they stayed in was by a river, and Hua caught a lot of fish. But the biggest fish got away.Hua tried skydiving and was very happy! EP10 A hard day.August 12, 2017Location: Norway Experience the Viking lifestyle and learn primitive methods of making fire.After experiencing many difficulties and finally reaching the top of the mountain, Hua was filled with emotions. EP11 diving and amusement parkAugust 19, 2017Location: Norway, Denmark Hua refused diving because of some trauma from his childhood. EP12 Hans Christian Andersen MuseumAugust 26, 2017Location: Denmark Performed several fairy tales at Hans Christian Andersen Museum. EP13 Touching FarewellSeptember 2, 2017Location: Denmark, Egeskov Castle Martians are not afraid of fire!Tried the maze and stilts.

posts.title: Anecdote (Updated on Nov., 2024)
posts.text: A summary of what you should know as a fan.Newly updated content is preceded by a “NEW⇒” symbol. Hua’s parents divorced when he was very young. He was raised by his father without any inconvenience. He also has a half-sister who is much younger than him. Hua learned the flute as a child and later the piano. Starting around the age of 11 or 12, he began experimenting with composing music. Hua’s philosophy is that the sound produced by humans is also a musical instrument, and there is no difference between the status of vocals and accompaniments in songs. As a result, since he was still studying at the conservatory of music, he had nothing in common with his classmates and singers. Because they are more interested in singing ability and technique than in the music itself. When Hua was at school, he often picked up and raised various small animals. Not just cats and dogs, but also geckos, lizards, spiders and more. NEW⇒Hua once adopted a stray dog, but gave it away because he had no time to take care of it. His current pet is a German curly cat named “Perper”, a gift from a friend. Hua has a special skill where he can catch a fly with his bare hands and then throw it to the ground violently to kill it. Hua loves to eat, but he will fast from solid food for a day or two before singing to keep his throat clear. His favorite food is roasted lamb leg and ice cream, and the food he will never eat is Taiwan’s famous snack Ti hoeh koe (pig blood cake). More people than expected mistakenly believe that “Hua hua” and “Hua Chenyu” are two different people. Hua likes Japanese ACG, and is a big fan of “One Piece” and “Tokyo Ghoul”. He also speaks a little Japanese. Hua was happy because the silver hair style on the promotional poster for “Mars Concert 2017“ looked a bit like Ken Kaneki. Hua even wore Chopper’s hat to the awards ceremony. Hua used to like to compose music naked in a dark room with only a piano. The medium-tempo rock song “Let You Go“ from Hua’s first album was composed in one breath within 4 minutes. There are a lot of DEMOs stored on Hua’s old computer and mobile phone. Fans are always trying their best to convince him to release more DEMOs. Hua’s not good at expressing things in words, so the only song he wrote his own lyrics for was “WhynobodyFights“ which had only one sentence. When singing impromptu, Hua always starts with “Today, I…” and sings casually. Hua’s catchphrase in the early days of his career was “Be casual (随意点)”. Although Hua’s writing is not very good, his thinking is always very clear during interviews. Therefore, he is also called the “Golden Sentence Hua” by fans. When singing rock music, Hua has a habit of stepping on something (a speaker or a special steel stand) with his right foot. When Hua raps, he always holds the microphone with his left hand and the fingers of his right hand dance rapidly to the rhythm. Because Hua’s singing ability is so high, he can produce great sounds even with inferior speakers. That’s why his fans call him “The Speaker Repairman”. When the previous performer’s poor singing leads the audience to believe that the sound equipment is not good, Hua’s performance will prove the quality of the sound equipment. The contestant number assigned to Hua when he participated in his debut program “Superboy 2013“ was “08042”. When asked in an interview about his goal for participating in the competition, Hua replied: “As long as I can get a ranking.” “Champion? A championship is okay.” Then he really won the championship. When first debuted, Hua was often referred to as the “boy from Mars (火星弟弟)” by the media, due to his slightly strange personality. So he simply made “MARS” his image symbol, and named his personal concert “Mars Concert (火星演唱会)“. At the annual “Mars Concert“, Hua would open with a “Welcome home (欢迎回家)” greeting. By the way, fans also got a nickname, “Martian(ET)“. Because Mars is a red planet, Hua’s support color is “red”. Fans always wear red clothes or tie red ribbons on their wrists when attending shows. Personal brand logo often used for concerts and related goods is: Not even once was he able to snap up tickets to his own “Mars Concert“. From his debut until 2025, Hua has taken a selfie in the same outfit and pose every year on his birthday to post on SNS. When taking selfies, Hua always gestures with his index and middle fingers together and the back of his hand facing out. Hua’s close friend, Zuo Li, is his roommate during the recording of his debut program “Superboy 2013“. When Zuo Li got married, Hua called the TOP 10 contestants one by one and invited them to gather at the wedding. He has close daily contact with Zuo Li and his wife. Hua humbly says “I can’t do that” whenever he needs to try a new skill, but learns it quickly each time. For example, singing coloratura, dancing tango, playing rare musical instrument, limbo game, etc. Hua once said, “I’m not very good at high notes.” But in fact, gorgeous high notes are Hua’s specialty. When taking photos with multiple people, Hua always unintentionally strikes a different gesture or pose than the others. "I'm different from everyone else" series: Hua occasionally remains still for long periods of time. Unless someone else happens to be moving, the animated .gif image may be mistaken for a still .jpg image. "jpg.gif" series: In 2016, when Hua attended the red carpet of [Cool Music Asia Celebration] (/liveevent2016/# Cool Music Asia Celebration/), his style was still a long-haired “Whiskers Hua (须须)”. However, when he appeared at the official venue, his hair had been shortened. According to fans present, he casually cut off his bangs backstage because fans were yelling at him to cut his bangs at red carpet. At Mars Concert 2021, Hua found a family playing mahjong in the audience, and then left a message to his fans on SNS saying: “Be bigger and stronger (做大做强), and be Pure Suit (清一色, a high-end way to win in mahjong)!” Since then, “Be bigger and stronger” has become the slogan of all fans and Hua himself. . At Mars Concert 2021, Hua and Zuo Li imitated how they would perform a concert when they were 60 years old. Hua pretended to cough while singing “I Don’t Care (我管你)“. In 2022 Hua got several tattoos. However, according to Chinese regulations, tattoos are not allowed to be shown on TV shows, so everyone can only see his tattoos at performances that are not on TV and in behind-the-scenes Vlogs. The promotional photo for the song “Black and White Artist“, which mocks anti-fans, depicts a piano with the “E” and “D” keys pressed. The tones of these two keys are very similar to the pronunciation of the phrase “idiot” in Chinese. NEW⇒After the last performance of the tour in the first half of 2023, Hua suddenly started a live broadcast, chatting with fans while eating barbecue. During the live broadcast, Hua told the story of why he had to take off his clothes when singing “Seven Personalities“ that day. The situation he described was very complicated, flustered and anxious, so he was nicknamed “Rushy Fluffy (急急小绒)” by fans. Official video for this “takes off” version of “Seven Personalities”. As a professional player of the mobile game “Game For Peace”, Hua always pretends that “celebrity endorsers @Hua Chenyu” and “esports professional player @花傲天” are two different people. And they are twins. He always refers to another identity as “my brother”. Therefore, many viewers who are not familiar with him really think that @花傲天, who became a professional player, is the twin brother of singer Hua Chenyu. NEW⇒The day after the MARS CONCERT 2024, Wuhan concert, Hua Chenyu strolled to the gate of his alma mater, Wuhan Conservatory of Music, to try to enter the campus, but was unable to enter because he did not have a reservation and the security guards did not recognize him.

posts.title: Biography
posts.text: Hua Chenyu, a male singer and songwriter from the People’s Republic of China, who also works as an arranger. He graduated from Wuhan Conservatory of Music. Hua’s main nickname in the media is “Hua hua (花花)”, which means flower. In September 2018, five years after his debut, Hua held a two-day personal concert at China’s largest stadium, the Beijing National Stadium (Bird’s Nest), becoming the first to do so among the singers born after 1990. Since 2021, Hua Chenyu has upgraded his personal concerts to outdoor rock festivals, each time builting a huge venue. The concert includes matinee and evening Show every day, as well as art installation and food street, attracting tens of thousands of spectators who dress up in flashy costumes and cosplay every day. They can enjoy a music carnival from afternoon to late night. On May 4, 2024, from 3 to 6 am, Hua Chenyu held the world’s first “Sunrise Concert“ with more than 100,000 spectators. Hua Chenyu Traditional Chinese: 華晨宇 Simplified Chinese: 华晨宇 Hanyu Pinyin: Huà Chén yŭ Place of Birth: Shiyan, Hubei Province, China Birth: February 7, 1990 Child: One daughter Biography Born on February 7, 1990, in Shiyan, Hubei Province, People’s Republic of China. Hua repeated his senior year of high school, and in 2010, he was admitted to his dream university - Wuhan Conservatory of Music, with the top score. In 2013, Hua debuted as the Champion of “Superboy 2013“, a musical talent competition which aims at uncovering talented tomorrow new male stars. In January 2014, Hua performed on the stage of The 2013 CCTV Spring Festival Gala (中国中央电视台春节联欢晚会). In September 2014, one year after his debut, Hua held a two-day personal concert with an audience of over 10,000 people at the Wukesong Arena in Beijing. In September 2014, Hua released his first album “Quasimodo’s Gift (卡西莫多的礼物)“. From July to August 2015, Hua held a three-day personal concert with an audience of over 10,000 people at the Shanghai Indoor Stadium. The personal concert on August 1 was broadcast in real time, recording 2.64 million online viewers. In December 2015, Hua released his second album “Aliens (异类)“. From July to September 2016, Hua held a three-day personal concert with an audience of over 10,000 people in Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen. In December 2016, Hua won the Best Asian Artist Award at the 2016 Mnet Asian Music Awards. In March 2017, Hua released his third album “H“. In October 2017, Hua held a two-day personal concert with an audience of over 10,000 people at the Wukesong Arena in Beijing. The personal concert on October 14 was broadcast in real time, recording 2.64 million online viewers. In September 2018, five years after his debut, Hua held a two-day personal concert at China’s largest stadium, the Beijing National Stadium (Bird’s Nest), becoming the first to do so among the singers born after 1990. In November 2019, Hua held a three-day personal concert at the Wuyuan River Stadium on Hainan Island. About 80% of the audience came from outside Hainan Island. According to local reports, sales at the airport duty-free shop on the first day of the concert increased by about 67%, and the live concert had a significant economic impact on the local area. On December 4, 2019, Hua released the single “I’m Here AKA I Really Want to Love This World (好想爱这个世界啊)“, broking China’s digital single sales record and music app’s purchase record. On February 21, 2020, Hua premiered the single “You Have To Believe This Is Not the Last Day (你要相信这不是最后一天)“ on the China singing talent show contest “Singer 2020“ to support people who have been severely affected by COVID19. This work reflects his strong feelings towards his hometown of Hubei Province and Wuhan, where he spent time in high school and university. In April 2020, Hua was declared winner (AKA King of Singers) of “Singer 2020“. At the time of the program’s broadcast, Hua became the youngest “King of Singers” in history since the program aired. In May 2020, Hua released his fourth album “NEW WORLD”. (Note: the MV for one of the main songs, “Bullfight (斗牛)“, was produced by a Japanese production team, directed by Mitsunori Yokobori, and animated by Yoshiki Imazu.) In 2020, Hua opened a new SNS account “Mars Space Station (火星空间站)“ and started operating his art toy brand“Masper”. On January 21, 2021, rumors spread on the internet that Hua Chenyu and female singer Zhang Bichen have a 2-year-old daughter. The next day, Hua admitted that he has a daughter. Immediately afterwards, Hua’s studio commented to the media that “Hua Chenyu is currently single, and the two of them will raise their child together on the premise that they will not get married, and they will be both involved in the child’s growth process.” From November 26 to December 5, 2021, Hua held a six-day personal concert at the Changying Wonderland in Haikou, and premiered one new song each day, for a total of six new songs. Hua served as the general director of this concert and built a huge venue on the lawn square of the amusement park. The concert was in the form of a music festival without seats, and included two performances each day, “Matinee (2:07pm-4:30pm)” and “Evening Show (19:30pm-22:00pm)”. On September 25, 2022, Hua Chenyu held an online concert “Mars Chapter“ for the 9th anniversary of his debut, rearranged 11 songs in collaboration with a symphony orchestra and choir, and experienced orchestra conducting and acapella singing for the first time. The two-hour live broadcast exceeded 200 million online views. In December 2022, Hua released his fifth album “希忘Hope“. In 2023, Hua Chenyu held a live tour around China in the style of a rock festival. The theme of this tour is to take fans to the great rivers and mountains of the motherland, and Hua even promised an all-night sunrise concert. In the first half of the year, Hua has held a total of 11 live concerts in four cities: Hangzhou, Chengdu, Wuhan, and Changsha. On May 30, 2023, Hua Chenyu was certified by the Peace Elite League (PEL) under the ID of @花傲天, and officially registered with the Hangzhou LGD Team as a youth player (Attacker). The name “傲天” describes an arrogant, conceited, and invincible character that appears in Chinese internet novels and Japanese Comic. On September 9, 2023, Hua Chenyu once again held a two-day personal concert at the Beijing National Stadium (Bird’s Nest). The theme of this concert is a perfect report in which he looks back on the 10 years since his debut. This is Bird’s Nest’s first four-sided stage after the Olympic opening ceremony. The design and construction were also handled by the production team of the 2008 Beijing Olympic and 2022 Beijing Winter Olympic Opening and Closing Ceremonies, who are also Hua Chenyu’s fans. Naturally, Hua also set a record of 100,000 viewers for a single concert in China. On May 4, 2024, Hua Chenyu finally fulfilled his promise after 3 years to hold a concert where he can watch the sunrise with his fans! The world’s first solo concert to greet the sunrise in the early morning. Fortunately, after several days of cloudy weather, everyone finally saw the sunrise! The Sunrise Concert was held from 3:00 am to 6:00 am, and more than 100,000 people greeted the sunrise while singing “Growing Toward the Sun (向阳而生)“! On May 24-26, 2024, Hua Chenyu held his first personal concert outside mainland China in Hong Kong. The concert still took the form of a rock festival, and was held for three consecutive days at the Central Harbourfront Event Space, facing the Victoria Harbour. NEW⇒ In January 2025, Hua released his sixth album “TIPPING POINT (量变临界点)“.

posts.title: About the Fans (Updated on Jan. 2026)
posts.text: Information and anecdote about Hua Chenyu’s fans. 1. NicknameWhen first debuted, Hua Chenyu was often referred to as the “boy from Mars (火星弟弟)” by the media, due to his slightly strange personality. Hua simply made “MARS” his image symbol, and also gave his fans the nickname “Martian (ET)”. Because Mars is a red planet, Hua’s support color is “red”. Fans always wear red clothes or tie red ribbons on their wrists when attending shows, that’s why their first nickname was “Miss Martian (火小姐)”. At Mars Concert 2014 and Mars Concert 2015, Hua Chenyu changed the song “Miss Dong (董小姐)” to “Miss Martian (火小姐)” and sang it. However, no one knows when, the image of a black sphere began to become popular. Fans gave themselves the name “Charcoal ball (黑煤球)”. According to fanarts, Black Coal Ball, who always follows Hua Chenyu (Big Brother (大哥)), occupies the position of Hua Chenyu’s pet. At the Mars Concert 2023, Hangzhou performance, Hua Chenyu called the audience “Charcoal ball” for the first time. In “MARS CONCERT 2018”, Hua claimed to be the uncle of the “Er-jie (二姐)” (actress Zhang Xinyi)’s unborn baby, and also recognized fans as “aunts”. During the 2023 Guangzhou concert, right before his most high-energy song, Hua Chenyu used a then-viral internet meme in his MC segment: “Princess, please dance” (公主请蹦迪). This moment led to “Princess” becoming the official nickname for all his fans—even male fans are affectionately called “Male Princesses.” Since then, it has become a tradition at his concerts for the staff to address every audience member with the honorific “Princess” while providing assistance. 2. Participate in CreationHua Chenyu often invites fans to participate in his creations and performances. “Why Nobody Fights“ To create the mysterious “choir-inspired” feeling that he wanted, many people would need to participate. Hua then invited his fans to participate. One hundred fans gathered at a large orchestral recording studio to complete the accompaniment and achieve the dramatic choral effect he had hoped for.Throughout the night, Hua Chenyu continued to provide guidance to the fans participating in the recording. Making Film “I Don’t Care“ On May 30, 2015, Hua invited 100 fans to record the harmony when recording the Remix version (Real-Me version) as an advertising jingle. “Conversations with Martian Children“ This is Hua Chenyu’s first duet song since his debut, showing the bond between him and his fans.Hua invites fans of all ages and social status to sit around and chat with them, and then organizes the chat content into lyrics.This communication process was also recorded into a MV. In the MV, Hua and fans asked each other questions and wrote down what they wanted to say to each other. MV 3. Formal PerformanceWhen fans sing together at formal events (such as live concerts or music festivals), they call themselves the “The Martian Super Band (ET天团)”. “天团” means “top idol group”.In an SNS post in 2016, Hua recognized the title of “The Martian Super Band” and called himself “just an accompanist.” “Quasimodo’s Gift“ “MARS CONCERT 2016“ Shanghai performance is The Martian Super Band’s debut stage.Since then, Hua will serve as an accompanist at every personal concert, providing The Martian Super Band with the opportunity to perform. Mars Concert 2016 “The World is a Zoo“ When performing the song “The World is a Zoo (世界是个动物园)“, Hua always sings “oiaioiaioiaiaio” with a random melody and makes his fans repeat it. The melody gradually becomes more complex, and it always ends on a high note that fans can’t sing, thus becoming a reason for Hua to laugh at his fans. Mars Concert 2016 Mars Concert 2023 “King and Beggar“ This song is also a masterpiece of The Martian Super Band, but every time they sing it, they always get the wrong beat in the last line. So they was laughed at by Hua every time because of this. Mars Concert 2017 Mars Concert 2019 “Why Nobody Fights“ This is Hua’s first song written specifically for fans and is suitable for thousands of people to sing together in a big venue like a stadium. Hua always sings this song with fans at live performances and music festivals. Mars Concert 2018 “Ashes from Fireworks“ On the first day of Mars Concert 2018, The Martian Super Band sang two songs: “Ashes from Fireworks“ and “My Skateboard Shoes 2016“.The harmony at the end of “Ashes from Fireworks“ was a new version adapted from “Child“, which has never been released before. But The Martian Super Band tacitly sang it correctly when they heard the melody for the first time. It surprised Hua Chenyu a lot. Mars Concert 2018 “Aliens” of 120,000 Yuan On the second day of Mars Concert 2018, at the insistence of The Martian Super Band, Hua allowed them to sing Aliens with his improvised piano accompaniment.Because of this song, the concert exceeded the scheduled end time by 6 minutes, causing Hua to pay a fine of 120,000 yuan. Therefore, this song was later nicknamed “Aliens of 120,000 Yuan”. Mars Concert 2018 “For Forever“ The Chinese pronunciation of “For Forever“ is similar to “Hua hua loves me”.At Mars Concert 2018, Hua personally admitted this nickname and made a request: “If you change the title of the song to ‘Hua hua loves me’, it will be your turn to sing! I just need to fly around in the sky!” Then he sang the song while flying above the stadium seats. Day 1 Day 2 “Conversations with Martian Children“ Half a month before “Mars Concert 2019“, Hua released this song, giving fans enough time to learn to sing. Then in “Mars Concert 2019“, The Martian Super Band and Hua’s first duet was successful. Mars Concert 2019 Opening Show of “The Coming One: Crystal Time” The opening show was a rock song “Aliens“. Hua climbed onto the railing in front of the stands while singing. The all-girl audience became even more enthusiastic.As a result, the audience’s chorus was too neat and had to be reshot. Opening Show “Illusion and Reality“ The song has a marching section, and for the studio version Hua altered his vocals and recorded nearly a hundred tracks to sing out this kind of chorus-like momentum. However, from the Mars Concert 2024, Hua has left this chorus to the fans, and has been pointing the microphone at the audience from start to finish. Mars Concert 2024, Hefei Concert “Here We Are“ Rap PK Suona In the Mars Concert 2024 tour, “Here We Are“ was re-adapted into a Chinese Folk version, and a suona solo was added as accompaniment in the rap before the end.Suona is called the “instrument rogue” because of its high-pitched loud sound, and its sound can even overwhelm an entire symphony orchestra.Hua Chenyu invited the audience to sing this rap together, and after practicing at each stop of the tour, it gradually evolved into a PK battle between the audience’s rap and the suona solo. Mars Concert 2024, Hangzhou Concert “Ship of Theseus“‘s Polyphonic HarmoniesPolyphonic Chorus of “Ship of Theseus” This song’s arrangement incorporates polyphony, a compositional technique where multiple independent melodies overlap simultaneously. During the recording process, Hua Chenyu performed the female polyphonic parts himself. At every live performance, fans spontaneously hum those female parts, creating a breathtaking and ethereal effect through a chorus of tens of thousands of voices. Mars Concert 2024, Hangzhou Concert Singing “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End“ for Hua as He Dines on Stage After winning a “weather-based bet” against his fans during the rainy Foshan concerts in Mars Concerts 2025, Hua Chenyu proposed a fun trade-off for the Qingdao concert: he wanted to experience the same pleasure fans have—relaxing, eating, and even lying down while watching a concert! Consequently, at the following Qingdao concert, the fans performed a full sing-along of “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End“. This allowed Hua to relax on stage, enjoying local barbecue and beer. He even shared a toast with his band and downed a full glass of beer on the spot. Mars Concert 2025, Qingdao Concert “Warm House“ Sing-along During the Mars Concert 2025 Shenyang concert, Hua responded to a request from the live stream comments from the night before, by performing an impromptu accompaniment for “Warm House“. Although there was a brief moment where he played the wrong note since it was unrehearsed, the song has since become a regular sing-along staple at his concerts. Mars Concert 2025, Shenyang Concert “We Meet When Flowers Fade“ — A Long-standing Chorus Tradition Originally, during the rock theme park-style concerts, the musical transition featured only a keyboard solo accompanied by artificial snow effects. However, it became a tradition after the audience spontaneously began singing along. Since then, even in four-sided stadium stage concerts, it has become a staple for Hua himself to play the piano and accompany the fans as they sing in unison. Mars Concert 2023, Beijing Concert Maestro Hua: Leading the A Cappella Since it rained at the previous Chengdu concert, Hua Chenyu won the “weather-based bet” again for the Zhengzhou concert. His prize request was an a cappella chorus performed by the entire audience. He divided the tens of thousands of fans into three vocal sections based on their seating areas and taught each group a one-measure melody. By snapping his fingers and waving his arms to conduct the rhythm while singing the lead melody himself, he led the entire stadium in a collaborative a cappella rendition of “Mayfly“. Mars Concert 2025, Zhengzhou Concert: A Cappella

posts.title: Folding (声希)
posts.text: After being performed at the “Yin-trend Music Night” on January 13, 2019, “Folding (声希)” was released online for a limited time of 100 hours.Then, in the second half of 2023, during the Mars Concert 2023 Stadium tour, Hua used this lyricless song as the opening song. 1. About the song There is a Chinese idiom called “大音希声”, which means “The greatest music has the faintest notes. the most astounding sound is not audible.”“Folding (声希)” is the representative work of modern dance artist Shen Wei. Hua Chenyu added human voices to the pure music based on his own understanding, further raising the level of this work. Vocal: Hua Chenyuchoreographer: Shen Wei 2. posts.title: Spark·Flame (火花Flame)
posts.text: On October 13, 2024, character song “Spark·Flame (火花Flame” for the Peace Super Group “space-time Concerto: Spark (时空协奏曲：火花)”, sung by Hua Chenyu, was officially released.Hua cosplayed as this character to film the MV. Videos20241018 “PEACE NIGHT” Official Video MV Lyrics TranslationLyricist: Lvy YiqiuCompose: KOBYEOUNGSIK, LEEHYUNGSUNG, CLEFCREWArrange: Bernard Zheng 火花Flame Spark·Flame 如火 别入魔 混沌不是我 Like fire, don’t be consumed, chaos is not me 轮回之中他们可曾 分出因果 In cycles of life, have theyever separated cause and effect? 歌颂 瞳孔里 最后那团火 Sing praise to the last flameburning in those eyes 这片时空越珍视伤痛才越鲜活 In this time and space,you’re alive the more you cherish the pain 别妄图干涉 我燃烧的轮廓 Don’t try to interfere withmy burning silhouette 我绽出 火花才不管会把谁烧成飞灰 I ignite the flames,uncaring of who will turn into ash 我擅作自我 不擅假意迎合 I excel at being myself, not at pretending 那子弹 瞄准的是我却从未曾 将我击溃 That bullet aims for mebut has never brought me down 任沉默 的躯体 The body left silent 装悦耳的魂灵 Holds a melodius soul 组成 无数矛盾的乐章 Forming a symphony of contradictions 协奏在此刻 Playing at this moment I’m a hero I’m a hero 寻找这场硝烟弥漫落幕的信号 Searching for the signalfor this battle to end I’m a hero I’m a hero 专注才是治愈纷乱 唯一的解药 Focus is the only cure for chaos I’m a hero I’m a hero

posts.title: MARS CONCERT 2018
posts.text: Time: September 8 - 9 Location: Beijing National Stadium (Bird’s Nest) No guests invited » Ticket Purchase Guide « 1. AchievementsIn September 2018, five years after his debut, Hua held a two-day personal concert at China’s largest stadium, the Beijing National Stadium (Bird’s Nest), becoming the first to do so among the singers born after 1990. Tickets on the first day were sold out in just 1 minute and 56 seconds. Tickets for the temporarily added second concert were sold out in 2 minutes and 58 seconds. A jaw-dropping showcase of wire-work enabled Hua to fly freely above his audience and even do consecutive barrel rolls while singing. The documentary of Mars Concert 2018 was included in Hua Chenyu’s 4th album “NEW WORLD“ as a USB version bonus. 2. Anecdote On the first day, actress Zhang Xinyi (Er-jie), whom Hua Chenyu met on the travel program “Flowers on Trip“, came to the concert. She was pregnant, and Hua Chenyu considered himself the uncle of her unborn baby, so he sang a song “To my Future Child“ for the future baby. There is a line in the lyrics of “To my Future Child“ that calls out “My dear baby”. Whenever Hua sang this line, the fans responded in unison with “Yes!”. Since then, fans have claimed that they are the aunt (of Er-jie’s future baby). Hua was shocked and acquiesced to the title, and used the title “the 90,000 aunts present” during the concert the next day. The Chinese pronunciation of “For Forever“ is similar to “Hua hua loves me”. At this concert, Hua Chenyu personally admitted this nickname and made a request: “If you change the title of the song to ‘Hua hua loves me’, it will be your turn to sing! I just need to fly around in the sky!” Then he sang the song while flying above the stadium seats. On the first day, ET sang two songs: “Ashes from Fireworks“ and “My Skateboard Shoes 2016“. The harmony at the end of “Ashes from Fireworks“ was a new version adapted from “Child“, which has never been released before. But ET tacitly sang it correctly when they heard the melody for the first time. It surprised Hua Chenyu a lot. The next day, at the insistence of ET, Hua allowed ET to sing Aliens with his improvised piano accompaniment. Because of this song, the concert exceeded the scheduled end time by 6 minutes, causing Hua to pay a fine of 120,000 yuan. Therefore, this song was later nicknamed “Aliens of 120,000 Yuan”. Five years ago, when Hua Chenyu first debuted, he promised his fans: “In 5 years, 10 years, 15 years, 20 years, I will always stand on the stage. I won’t let you regret choosing me.” This concert is the first time this promise has been fulfilled. “2018 Mars Concert (Bird’s Nest) documentary” was included in Hua Chenyu’s 4th album “NEW WORLD“ as a USB version bonus. The next day, after singing the final encore song “I am What I am“, Hua sang a new song “New World“ that has not yet been released, and declared to the fans, “From now on, I will take you into the new world.” Since then, Hua Chenyu has continued to emphasize the concept of “New World” and released an album of the same name in 2020. During the two-day performance, Hua Chenyu’s throat condition was in poor condition, and he even had painkillers injected into his throat to be able to make a sound. 3. posts.title: "MARS CONCERT (火星演唱会)" list
posts.text: » Ticket Purchase Guide « OriginWhen first debuted, Hua Chenyu was often referred to as the “boy from Mars (火星弟弟)” by the media, due to his slightly strange personality.Hua simply made “MARS” his image symbol, and promised his fans that “someday we will return to Mars together”. To fulfill this promise, Hua named his personal concert “MARS CONCERT (火星演唱会)”.By the way, His fans also received the nickname “ET (Martian，火星人)“. Achievements In 2021, Hua Chenyu pioneered the rock theme park-style concerts in the form of an outdoor music festival. The world’s first solo concert specifically be held in the early morning to greet the sunrise. Being the youngest singer to hold a personal concert at China’s largest stadium, the Beijing National Stadium (Bird’s Nest), and the only singer under the age of 30 to hold a concert there. Also being the first singer to introduce a four-sided stage to the Bird’s Nest, setting a record for a personal concert in China by attracting 100,000 people to a single performance. The stage design has won the MUSE Design Awards four times. Among them, 2021’s Rock Theme Park-Style Concerts, 2023’s four-sided stage in the Bird’s Nest, and 2024’s Sunrise Concert all won the Platinum Award in 2024; and the lighting design of Mars Concert 2024’s four-sided stage won the Lighting Design of the Year in 2025. Breaking records for the largest audience in a single concert at stadiums in various cities Regular Parts of MARS CONCERT Greet fans with “Welcome home (欢迎回家)” as the first greeting. When performing the song “The World is a Zoo (世界是个动物园)“, Hua always sings “oiaioiaioiaiaio” with a random melody and makes his fans repeat it. The melody gradually becomes more complex, and it always ends on a high note that fans can’t sing, thus becoming a reason for Hua to laugh at his fans. Before the concert ends, be sure to thank each staff and partner, such as band members, company, security team, fire brigade, etc. Every time Hua pronounces a name, ETs shout “Thank you”. From 2014 to 2017, always sing Leslie Cheung’s famous song I Am What I Am (我) as the last encore. Since this is a very special song for Hua and he only has the strength to sing it once a year, he wanted to use that only opportunity for MARS CONCERT. In 2018, after singing I Am What I Am (我), Hua went on to sing an unreleased new song “New World (新世界)” and declared to fans, “From now on, I will take you to a new world.” Through this action, Hua embarked on a new journey in his life. Starting in 2021, MARS CONCERT has been upgraded to an outdoor rock festival. Hua put his rock songs in the more exciting Evening Show, and put his early songs and some pop songs in the more relaxed Matinee. Also, rearranging songs into unplugged version for Matinee and singing along with guest Zuo Li has become a regular occurrence. We don’t know since when, fans started asking Hua for kisses during impromptu interactions, and Hua always satisfied fans with a “kiss song” after a “brewing”. During the performance of “Ship of Theseus“, fans in the audience spontaneously hummed polyphonic harmonies, creating a magnificent choral effect. For the song “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology“, band members automatically lined up behind Hua to patrol the venue, wearing hilarious masks/headpieces secretly prepared with unique themes for each show. Both the stage crew and audience eagerly anticipated Hua’s reactions—whether laughter or shock—to these surprises. Classic themes included “Calabash Brothers” (a Chinese animated series); “Teletubbies” (with Hua mimicking their tiptoe wobble and bouncing); “Plants vs. Zombies” (Hua imitating a Peashooter); Hangzhou’s “The Legend of the White Snake”; and Changsha’s “Dorky Orange (呆橘)“ series alongside petrified-with-shock memes (which Hua mistakenly thought were “Charcoal ball (黑煤球)“, leading him to affectionately pat his head). Since 2023, during each tour stop after the national college entrance examination every year, Hua Chenyu has invited outstanding examinees among his fans who have been admitted to China’s top universities, as well as excellent teachers from the tour host cities, to watch the concert for free from the best seats. This initiative is named the “Mars Incentive Program”. NEW⇒ May 4 is the first anniversary of the sunrise concert. 2,000 drones were launched to simulate the sun and spell out the words: “You are my sun — by Big Brother. (你们就是我的太阳 ——大哥)”, setting a record for the number of drones launched above the concert venue. (Due to the large gathering of people at the performance site, for safety reasons, the launch of such a large number of drones is usually not allowed). Since then, a large-scale fireworks show and drone show have been arranged for every Rock Theme Park-Style Concert. posts.text: Time: Nov 15-17 Location: Haikou Wuyuan River Stadium No guests invited » Ticket Purchase Guide « 1. Achievements All tickets for the 3 performances sold out within 10 seconds. Hua Chenyu performed for three consecutive days on a 360-degree open stage at an outdoor stadium. This is the first time this has happened in mainland China. In just three weeks after it was announced that the concert originally scheduled to be held in Shenzhen was postponed due to force majeure, Hua Chenyu efficiently completed the work of finding a new venue, modifying the stage design, refunding tickets and reselling them. In the end, the concert was successfully held in Haikou after being postponed for only 2 weeks. According to local reports, sales at the duty-free shops increased by approximately 67% on the first day of the concert, indicating that the 3 consecutive concerts, over 150,000 tickets were sold, over 80% of the audience were from outside the province, had a significant impact on the local economy. 2. Anecdote Official release of “Mars Triology“. The first song, “I’m Here AKA I Really Want to Love This World“, calls for a better understanding of depression patients. The second song is “Madhouse“ in a reggae style.. The third song is “Conversations with Martian Children“, which expresses Hua’s bond with his fans. -The mink fur coat was originally designed for winter, but it looked strange when worn in tropical Haikou. A different sentence was printed each day on the long ribbon paper that was sprayed at the end of the performance: Translation Original Day1 Welcome Home 欢迎回家 Day2 Thank you for still being here,in my country 谢谢你还在我的国 Day3 You’ve always been “red”,and I’ll always be “Red” 你们一直红，我就一直红 Hua rented a large number of buses at his own expense and set up free shuttle buses across the city directly to the concert site. Audiences can enjoy discounts at attractions and duty-free shops across Haikou with tickets for the concert. But Hua couldn’t snatch a ticket for his own concert. Before the tickets for Day 3 went on sale, Hua Chenyu, who had already failed twice, made a bet: “If I can’t buy it this time, I will shave my head.” As a result, his new hairstyle for the Haikou concert was the bald head that everyone expected. “I am What I am“, which had always been the last encore song, was used as the opening song this time. 3. posts.title: MARS CONCERT 2017
posts.text: Time: October 13 - 14 Location: Beijing LeSports Center » Ticket Purchase Guide « 1. Achievements Free online live streaming of two consecutive days of concerts had more than 200 million online views. The concert venue was still a stadium that can accommodate more than 10,000 people, and the stage was a center stage. 2. Anecdote In Chinese, the pronunciation of the date 13-14 is similar to “a whole lifetime”. Wearing a white shirt and a silver cloak, Hua played “Always With Me (Spirited Away)” on the flute and was nicknamed “Mr. Prince Hua” by fans. The day after the concert, Hua suffered from severe tinnitus due to overwork, and even worried that “I might never be able to make music again in the future.” When Hua Chenyu created the song “Candle“, he sat in a pitch-black room with the only furniture as a piano, lit many candles around him, imagined the candlelight as glow sticks at a live concert, and completed the song all at once. Hua explained, “Even though I played some parts wrong on DEMO, the emotion contained within is perfect for this song.” and after writing this song, he could no longer find the feeling he had when he wrote it. He didn’t want to sing a song to the fans in such an imperfect way, so at the “Mars Concert 2017”, he played the DEMO directly at the concert, surrounding by glow sticks, and finished listening to this DEMO quietly with his fans. On the second day of the concert, the big screen randomly captured a couple kissing in the audience. Hua Chenyu expressed his confusion about this for several years: “Obviously what I sang was not a love song, why would they do such a thing at the concert?” However, what Hua Chenyu didn’t know was that the couple photographed at the time was a lesbian couple. 3. posts.title: “The Coming One” Season 1 (明日之子第一季)
posts.text: From June to September 2017, Hua Chenyu participated in Tencent Video’s girl idol discovery and development variety show “The Coming One (明日之子)” as a regular mentor. 1. About the showThe program divides the contestants into three groups: the “Beauty Track (美颜赛道)” which focuses on appearance, the “Talent Track (独秀赛道)” which focuses on creative ability and the “Vocal Track (魔音赛道)” which focuses on vocal ability. Hua serves as the mentor of “Vocal Track”. In addition, the mentor for the “Beauty Track” is Yang Mi, a popular Chinese actress, and the mentor for the “Talent Track” is Joker Xue, a singer-songwriter who is good at writing lyrics. 2. Anecdote Later in the show, Hua cut his hair very short in another variety show “Flowers on Trip (旅途的花样)“. He was nicknamed “Shell-head Brother (壳哥)” because his short hair was like a smooth eggshell. He shed tears while singing “Forest Polka” for the eliminated contestant Meng Zikun. In EP12, there is a part where the mentor and the contestant perform together. On the day of filming, although Hua Chenyu had a fever, he still performed two intense songs perfectly. After the performance, Hua had to lean on the host to stand firm. Also in EP12, Hua was filmed secretly cutting his nails with nail clippers. This was in preparation for playing the piano in a subsequent performance. The scene where Hua secretly picked up trash under the table after cutting his nails was also captured by fans on their mobile phones. Among the contestants, a virtual singer named HeZ was assigned to Hua Chenyu’s “Vocal Track”. The addition of virtual singers caused huge controversy in public opinion. Many viewers believed that the program production team lost fairness in pursuit of topicality. Because the mainstream public opinion ignored the virtual singer’s musical ability and directly denied the value of his existence, Hua felt very disappointed. When HeZ was eliminated, Hua shed tears again. 3. About the song“The Next” (also known as “Sound of War”) is a singing competition/show where anyone can challenge mature singers. The song the challenger chose for the singer warrior will then be revealed, and the singer warrior must compete with their challenger by singing the chosen song. The singer warriors have 24 hours to rearrange to chosen songs, and after 24 hours, they will face their challengers on the stage with 400 audiences who would cast their votes to decide the winner. In the second half of the competition, each of the surviving challengers form a combination with a singer, and compete against other teams by performing together. “If You Were Li Bei” is a satirical song about a breakup. The “Li Bai” mentioned in the song refers to Li Bai, a poet from the prosperous Tang Dynasty in China who was called the “Immortal of Poetry” by later generations. The lyrics also quote Li Bai’s masterpiece “Quiet Night Thought (静夜思)” (included in Chinese primary school Chinese textbooks). Hua Chenyu rearranged the song. posts.title: “The Coming One: Crystal Time” (明日之子：水晶时代)
posts.text: On June 15, 2019, Hua Chenyu participated in Tencent Video’s girl idol discovery and development variety show “The Coming One: Crystal Time (明日之子：水晶时代)” as a regular mentor. 1. About the showThis season, the contestants are divided into two groups: “START” and “RESTART” based on whether they have debuted before, and the number of mentors has also increased to six. As one of the six members, Hua pays more attention to vocal music and stage presence. Girl contestants will attain their “Strongest Brand Names” through constant progress. In addition to Hua Chenyu, the regular mentors include Stefanie Sun(a Singaporean female singer who can represent the Chinese music scene), Song Dandan (one of China’s top actresses/comedians), Long Danni (the most famous founder of China’s idol talent show), Mao Buyi (champion of “The Coming One Season 1“), Meng Meiqi (a member of the Chinese girl group “Rocket Girls 101” in 2018). Through tasks, practices, exams, the contestants will grow under the guidance of the mentors and eventually produce the “Strongest Brands.” 2. Anecdote The person who got this job was HCY148‘s new member “Sa Sa (飒飒)”. With his slightly curly short hair and charm like a comic book protagonist, he was called “飒飒” which means valiantly dashing. The opening performance was a rock song “Aliens“. Hua climbed onto the railing in front of the stands while singing. The all-girl audience became even more enthusiastic. Also during the opening performance, the opening song had to be re-shot because the fans’ chorus was too neat. Hua was ill again this season, but still taught the contestant how to play the drums handsomely despite his illness. 3. posts.title: MARS CONCERT 2026
posts.text: Time Location Guest May 1-5(Cancelled) Fuxian Lake Music Show Venue,Yuxi » Ticket Purchase Guide « 1. Achievements “Mars Park-Style Concerts 2.0” continues the signature format of Matinee + Evening Show, providing a moment of non-stop revelry for fans to play all day long. Inside the amusement park, a diverse range of entertainment is offered, including integrates gaming, interactive zones, gourmet food, and various leisure activities. The stage design centers on the theme of “Eternity,” shattering the traditional single-format concert model to achieve breakthroughs in both visual presentation and content arrangement. While preserving the iconic artistic style of the Mars Concerts, it deeply integrates natural landscapes to create an exclusive stage that blends high-tech aesthetics with natural vibes, making the audience feel as if they are in a secret “Martian” realm. A brand-new “Twin Setlist” is introduced. By alternately performing different setlists across the tour dates, each show is given distinct highlights. Through this multi-layered musical experience, the audience can fully appreciate the unique charm of the stage created by Hua Chenyu. 2. AnecdoteYuxi (Cancelled) The performances scheduled for May 1-2 and 4-5, 2026, which were to serve as the opening stop for “Mars Park-Style Concerts 2.0” at Fuxian Lake (the second deepest freshwater lake in China) in Yuxi, Yunnan, were abruptly cancelled due to force majeure on April 22 – just one week before the event. Dismantling of the stage facilities, which cost over 2 billion JPY and were nearly complete, began that very night. According to media interviews and reports published before the cancellation, the decision to locate “Mars Park-Style Concerts 2.0” at Fuxian Lake was prompted by a warm invitation from Yuxi City. The event’s realization came only after navigating numerous challenges and setbacks. According to various estimates, the losses incurred by Hua Chenyu and the organizers from stage construction costs, hundreds of thousands of ticket refunds, VIP ticket perks and merchandise for sale, and compensation for flight and hotel cancellations alone will reach billions of JPY. This does not include investments in fixed assets such as local real estate purchases, infrastructure development, environmental protection support, and the establishment of supporting facilities. At the final concert last year, Hua Chenyu announced the purchase of three plots of land in Yunnan to build a physical “Mars Home”. These plots were designated for a permanent stage and audience area, lifestyle facilities like B&Bs and cafes, and the creation of a “Mars Utopia”. When the concert was cancelled, the B&B and cafe were already in operation. In particular, the B&B “Warm House” had previously selected guests (limited to concert-goers) via livestream to stay during the concert period for a special price of 3 RMB per day; all payments have now been refunded, and the offer has been changed to allow all booked guests to stay for free. On the night the cancellation was announced, Hua Chenyu held a Livestream, performing several songs rearranged specifically for the concerts to comfort his fans. A few days later, at the China Blue Zuili Lake Music Festival, Hua Chenyu revealed that on the very night he learned of the cancellation, he had organized a specialized task force to scout other Chinese cities for a new venue and had already dispatched them to the field. 3. posts.title: “The Coming One” Season 2 (明日之子第二季)
posts.text: From June to September 2018, Once again Hua Chenyu participated in Tencent Video’s girl idol discovery and development variety show “The Coming One Season 2 (明日之子第二季)” as a regular mentor. 1. About the showLike the first season, the show divides contestants into three groups: the “Beauty Track (美颜赛道)” which focuses on appearance, the “Talent Track (独秀赛道)” which focuses on creative ability and the “Vocal Track (魔音赛道)” which focuses on vocal ability.But except for Hua, all the mentors are different from the first season.This time, Li Yuchun, a legendary female singer with the most social influence in China, will serve as the mentor for the “Beauty Track”, and Wu Qingfeng, a singer-songwriter who is famous for his high notes, will serve as the mentor for the “Talent Track”. 2. Anecdote This season’s style is long curly hair tied up. Hua had a noble demeanor and a delicate vulnerability that earned him the nickname “Curly Hua (卷儿/卷鹅)”. The tears of “Curly Hua” were called “Fairy sheds tears” by fans. During the live broadcast, Hua played with his sleeves and finally tied the two sleeves with a knot from the inside, tying himself up. In EP7, Hua’s track made a bet that if no one was eliminated, they would dance together. After the show, Hua led everyone to dance to the brainwashing Internet hit song “Next Door Tarzan” during a live broadcast. During the recording, there was a power outage due to weather. The fans in the audience took turns singing the mentors’ masterpieces. In EP8, Hua’s stomach hurt to the point where his eyesight went straight. But he still persisted until the end of the live broadcast. The children Hua took care of on the reality show “Let Go My Baby! (放开我北鼻)“ visited the backstage. Hua sang “Twinkle Twinkle Little Star” to the children. 3. posts.title: Maiden Of Alisan (阿里山的姑娘 AKA 高山青)
posts.text: Adapted and performed for the first time in the 2017 singing competition “The Next S2“.Later, in the music program “Infinity and Beyond 2023 (声生不息宝岛季)“ EP4, Hua Chenyu collaborated with Na Ying and Ivy Lee to sing this classic Chinese folk song again in a completely different style. 1. About the song“Maiden Of Alisan” is the theme song of the 1949 movie “Happenings in Ali Shan (阿里山风云)”, which depicts the story of Taiwanese indigenous peoples called Gaoshan people. Because this song incorporates musical elements of the Gaoshan people, it is often mistaken for a traditional folk song of the Gaoshan people, but in fact it is not a true folk song. The composer and lyricist of the song were both involved in the production of the above-mentioned movie. They composed the song when they came to Taiwan from the mainland to film the movie. Later, the song became so popular that it was included in music textbooks on both sides of the Taiwan Strait and was covered by many famous singers. “Infinity and Beyond 2023” is a music program based on Taiwanese golden songs. Recordings were carried out in Changsha and Taipei at the same time, taking the time as a clue to comprehensively sort out the “Chinese Music Chronicle” with Taiwanese characteristics. Build bridges and bonds through literary and artistic works, continuously strengthen the common memory, emotion and consciousness of compatriots on both sides of the strait, and demonstrate the spiritual bond of Chinese culture. Its purpose is not only to invite young musicians to perform classic songs in today’s music style, but also to pass on famous songs to the new era and stimulate cultural exchanges. 2. posts.text: In the 2018 singing competition “The Next S2“ EP12,Hua Chenyu adapted and sang famous Chinese singer Faye Wong’s masterpiece “Idiot (白痴)”, with challenger Ma Lu . 1. About the song“The Next” (also known as “Sound of War”) is a singing competition/show where anyone can challenge mature singers. The song the challenger chose for the singer warrior will then be revealed, and the singer warrior must compete with their challenger by singing the chosen song. The singer warriors have 24 hours to rearrange to chosen songs, and after 24 hours, they will face their challengers on the stage with 400 audiences who would cast their votes to decide the winner. In the second half of the competition, each of the surviving challengers form a combination with a singer, and compete against other teams by performing together. Hua Chenyu used baroque polyphony (music composed of multiple independent voices) when adapting the song, and also designed a highly ritualistic stage design to create a unique atmosphere. During the performance, Hua sprained his waist. But later his stiff movements became part of the performance, helping him achieve better results. 2. Videos“The Next S2” EP12 3. posts.text: Derived from the openning song of the Chinese TV drama “Journey to the West”, “Yun Gong Xun Yin (Vocal-less)”.First released at singing competition “The Next S1“ EP7 in 2017. 1. About the song“The Next” (also known as “Sound of War”) is a singing competition/show where anyone can challenge mature singers. The song the challenger chose for the singer warrior will then be revealed, and the singer warrior must compete with their challenger by singing the chosen song. The singer warriors have 24 hours to rearrange to chosen songs, and after 24 hours, they will face their challengers on the stage with 400 audiences who would cast their votes to decide the winner. “Yun Gong Xun Yin” is the theme melody of the popular TV drama “Journey to the West” that aired in 1986. Because every Chinese is very familiar with this melody, it is very difficult to adapt it. As a result, Hua Chenyu’s performance was a great success, and the song also became Hua’s signature work. Originally, due to copyright, it could not be performed outside of the show, but around 2018, Hua Chenyu removed the melody of “Yun Gong Xun Yin” from the prelude and also changed the middle chorus to his own original melody.The original melody is the chorus melody he composed for “Nunchucks (双截棍)“, which he covered on the Singing Talent Show Contest “Singer 2018“. 2. posts.title: “The Next” Season 1 (天籁之战第一季) - Singing Competition
posts.text: From October 2016 to January 2017, Hua Chenyu participated in Dragon TV’s singing competition/show “The Next Season 1”. 1. About the show “The Next” (also known as “Sound of War”) is a singing competition/show where anyone can challenge mature singers, and fight for dreams to reach the top. From the start of each episode, 7 ordinary people from all walks of life will choose a singer to challenge, and each singer warrior (singers) would choose to accept a single challenger. The song the challenger chose for the singer warrior will then be revealed, and the singer warrior must compete with their challenger by singing the chosen song. The singer warriors have 24 hours to rearrange to chosen songs, and after 24 hours, they will face their challengers on the stage with 400 audiences who would cast their votes to decide the winner. On average, the rearrangement of a song goes along the lines of choosing a style, composing a demo, rearranging, settling the music sheets, rehearsals, etc. This process usually takes 1 week, but in “The Next”, the time is shortened to only 24 hours, with 4 singer warriors sharing one music band. In the second half of the competition, each of the surviving challengers form a combination with a singer, and compete against other teams by performing together.In addition to Hua, singers also includes Karen Mok, Fei Yu-ching and Yang Kun. Hua Chenyu fully demonstrated his songwriting ability and singing ability on the show. Taking this show as an opportunity, Hua relied on his own strength to reverse the negative image imposed on him by the media in the past three years, and has become increasingly popular not only in mainland China, but also in Taiwan and Southeast Asia. Through the show, Hua formed deep friendships with three senior singers, Karen Mok, Fei Yu-ching and Yang Kun. 2. Playlist“The Next S1” Full Versionhttps://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLGjsh-EBqdUMKcrd0yGj-kiClncWG1Yi- Collection of Hua Chenyu performances 3. Detailed information about each episode EP1: Wandering (流浪记)Original Singer: PanaiOctober 16, 2016 EP2: The Cloud Of Hometown (故乡的云)Original Singer: Fei XiangOctober 23, 2016 EP3: My Skateboard Shoes 2016 (我的滑板鞋2016)Original Singer: Joseeh PunmanlonOctober 30, 2016 The original song “My Skateboard Shoes” is a viral meme song, and is regarded as a so-bad-it’s-good kind of song. It has no rhyme or rhythm and Hua was able to rewrite the entire song into something coherent in 24 hours.Original versionThis arrangement has become one of Hua’s most widely sung masterpieces. EP4: Mice Loves Rice (老鼠爱大米)Original Singer: Yang ChengangNovember 6, 2016 A really cute performance! EP5: Dear friendOriginal Singer: ShunzaNovember 13, 2016 EP6 No PerformanceNovember 20, 2016 Draw a bye. Rest for one episode EP7: Great Sage Equal To Heaven (齐天大圣)Derived from the openning song of the Chinese TV drama “Journey to the West”, “Yun Gong Xun Yin (Vocal-less)”November 27, 2016 “Yun Gong Xun Yin” is a song without lyrics that everyone is familiar with in China, so the process of reorganizing it was extremely difficult. As a result, the performance was a great success, and the song also became Hua’s signature work. EP8: Itchy (痒)Served as Yang Kun’s support guestOriginal Singer: Huang LingDecember 4, 2016 EP9: Flammable and Explosive (易燃易爆炸)Original Singer: Chen LiDecember 11, 2016 During the song’s interlude, Hua Chenyu tried coloratura for the first time. EP10: Nanping Evening Bell (南屏晚钟)with Juno SuOriginal Singer: Tsui PingDecember 18, 2016 Hua stood on the piano and sang two 16-second high harmonies in succession, immediately after the rap. EP11: If You were Li Bei (如果你是李白)with Fan YuanyuanOriginal Singer: Karen MokDecember 25, 2016 EP12: Perhaps Love (如果爱)with Juno SuOriginal Singer: Musical “Perhaps Love”January 1, 2017 The theme of the finals is musical. In this performance, Hua Chenyu attempted tango for the first time.

posts.title: “The Next” Season 2 (天籁之战第二季) - Singing Competition
posts.text: From October 2017 to January 2018, Hua Chenyu participated in Dragon TV’s singing competition/show “The Next Season 2”. 1. About the show “The Next” (also known as “Sound of War”) is a singing competition/show where anyone can challenge mature singers, and fight for dreams to reach the top. From the start of each episode, 7 ordinary people from all walks of life will choose a singer to challenge, and each singer warrior (singers) would choose to accept a single challenger. The song the challenger chose for the singer warrior will then be revealed, and the singer warrior must compete with their challenger by singing the chosen song. The singer warriors have 24 hours to rearrange to chosen songs, and after 24 hours, they will face their challengers on the stage with 400 audiences who would cast their votes to decide the winner. On average, the rearrangement of a song goes along the lines of choosing a style, composing a demo, rearranging, settling the music sheets, rehearsals, etc. This process usually takes 1 week, but in “The Next”, the time is shortened to only 24 hours, with 4 singer warriors sharing one music band. In the second half of the competition, each of the surviving challengers form a combination with a singer, and compete against other teams by performing together. In addition to Hua, singers in the Season 2 also includes Karen Mok, Fei Yu-ching, Yang Kun and Jason Zhang. Karen Mok, whom Hua met in Season 1, asked Hua to compose for her new album. Coincidentally, a few years ago, Hua wrote down a DEMO suitable for Karen to sing and named it “Karen Mok”, so he gave the DEMO directly to Karen. The DEMO later became “Half a Lifelong Romance (半生缘)“, which is included in Karen’s new album.This was Hua’s first compose work for Others. 2. Playlist“The Next S2”Full Versionhttps://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLGjsh-EBqdUMxcbGDww3a6FZy-hp2Sep8 Collection of Hua Chenyu performances 3. Detailed information about each episode EP1: Maiden Of Alisan (阿里山的姑娘)Original Singer: QingshanOctober 15, 2017 In the first episode of Season 2, Hua Chenyu sang the Taiwanese folk song “Maiden Of Alisan” by adapting it to his own style. EP2: HEAVEN (天堂)Original Singer: TenggerOctober 29, 2017 Hua Chenyu adapted a Mongolian folk song that praised one’s hometown into a New Age style. EP3: The Phantom Lover (夜半歌声)Original Singer: Leslie CheungNovember 5, 2017 The recording of the show was on the second day of the “Mars Concert 2017“. Hua Chenyu suffered from severe tinnitus due to overwork, and even worried that “I might never be able to make music again in the future.”But he gave the song 100 percent respect. He did not make drastic changes, conveying all the emotions to the audience through just a piano and his voice. EP4: Endless Embrace (深情相拥)with Zhao YouqiaoOriginal Singer: Leslie Cheung ft Winnie HsinNovember 11, 2017 EP5: I’m Ugly, But I’m Very Gentle (我很丑可是我很温柔)Original Singer: Chief ChaoNovember 18, 2017 Hua Chenyu thinks of herself, “Although I’m not handsome, I’m not ugly either.” So in order to prevent the audience from focusing on his appearance, he chose to wear a black mask. EP6: Code Name Contra (代号魂斗罗)Derived from the theme melody of the game “Contra”November 25, 2017 Since there aren’t any instruments or vocals in the game’s MIDI soundtrack, it’s fair to say Hua Chenyu created an entirely new song in 24 hours rather than just rearranging it. EP7 No PerformanceDecember 2, 2017 Draw a bye. Rest for one episode EP8: Dad, I’m Home (爸，我回来了)Original Singer: Jay ChouDecember 9, 2017 The theme of this song is domestic violence, and Hua Chenyu perfectly played the image of a boy who suffered domestic violence in the form of the narration.After the show aired, many viewers who didn’t know the truth assumed that this was Hua’s real experience. EP9: Drunk As Lonely Hero (一人饮酒醉)December 16, 2017 “Drunk As Lonely Hero” is a representative work of the “喊麦 (shouting mic)” music category popular among Chinese folk. To put it simply, it is similar to rap freestyle.Hua Chenyu created a new song using Chinese classical music style, adding a poetic and beautiful melody to the original rap-like lyrics. EP10-11 No PerformanceDecember 23, 2017 Draw a bye. Rest for one episode EP12: Idiot (白痴)with Ma LuOriginal Singer: Faye WongJanuary 6, 2018 Hua Chenyu’s adaptation used the musical form of polyphony and a highly ceremonial stage design. EP13: Insignificance (渺小)with Geng SihanOriginal Singer: Hebe TienJanuary 13, 2018

posts.title: Dad, I'm Home (爸，我回来了)
posts.text: Hua Chenyu adapted and sang asian pop star Jay Chou’s “Dad, I’m Home (爸，我回来了)” at singing competition “The Next S2“ EP8 in 2017. 1. About the song“The Next” (also known as “Sound of War”) is a singing competition/show where anyone can challenge mature singers. The song the challenger chose for the singer warrior will then be revealed, and the singer warrior must compete with their challenger by singing the chosen song. The singer warriors have 24 hours to rearrange to chosen songs, and after 24 hours, they will face their challengers on the stage with 400 audiences who would cast their votes to decide the winner. The theme of this song is domestic violence, and Hua Chenyu used the form of recitation to perfectly interpret the image of a boy experiencing domestic violence. Because Hua’s performance was so immersive, after the show was broadcast, many viewers who did not know the truth thought that this was his real experience, which caused his father to suffer a lot of criticism. 2. About the song“The Next” (also known as “Sound of War”) is a singing competition/show where anyone can challenge mature singers. The song the challenger chose for the singer warrior will then be revealed, and the singer warrior must compete with their challenger by singing the chosen song. The singer warriors have 24 hours to rearrange to chosen songs, and after 24 hours, they will face their challengers on the stage with 400 audiences who would cast their votes to decide the winner. “Drunk As Lonely Hero” is a representative work of the “喊麦 (shouting mic)” music category popular among Chinese folk. posts.title: Skincare Brand “重点POINZ”
posts.text: As a co-founder, Hua Chenyu launched the skincare brand “重点POINZ”.The brand was co-founded by Xiaokuo Group (the parent company of the oral care brand Canban, for which Hua Chenyu serves as the ambassador) and Hua himself. This signifies that Hua Chenyu is no longer merely a brand ambassador; instead, he is deeply involved in every step of the brand’s chain, from product R&D to visual identity creation, in his capacity as a co-founder.With the core philosophy of “Smoothing out life’s little burrs”, POINZ is committed to pioneering a world of “Micro-care”, advocating a lifestyle that encourages people to “Focus on the essentials, and live a little more relaxed”. Its debut collection covers high-frequency daily essentials, including floral water, plant essential oil bracelets, cooling lithospermum soothing balm, hand cream, and lip balm. Offline EventsMarch 22, 2026 To celebrate the brand’s launch, a pop-up store opened in Hangzhou. That evening, Hua Chenyu made a surprise appearance at the venue to interact with fans and conduct a live stream.Due to the last-minute nature of the decision, Hua paired a red hat with a yellow tie found at his home to match the brand’s design style. This look was jokingly dubbed the “Trump-style outfit” among fans and became a hot topic.

posts.title: The Ordinary Path (平凡之路)
posts.text: On March 30, 2018, Hua Chenyu adapted and sang Chinese rock star Pu Shu’s masterpiece “The Ordinary Path (平凡之路)” in the singing contest “Singer 2018“ EP11. 1. posts.title: Fake Monk (假行僧)
posts.text: Hua Chenyu sang Chinese rock star Cui Jian’s masterpiece “Fake Monk (假行僧)” in his debut show “Superboy 2013“ in 2013 and in the singing contest “Singer 2018“ EP10 in March, 2018. Both times he made subversive arrangements of the songs. 1. About the songFive years ago, in “Superboy 2013“, Hua Chenyu, who was still an amateur, stood barefoot on the stage and expressed this 90s song in the form of psychedelic rock. Five years later, Hua Chenyu adapted this song again and presented a shocking experimental music piece with a completely different atmosphere in “Singer 2018“, showing his growth. “Singer 2018” backstage interview (excerpt) A small child, the ones they need to be closest to are the ones that provide food to them. And these people are their parents.If the parents aren’t by their side for long periods of times, they will think that if they can’t even receive love from the people they trust the most, then it will be harder to receive love from others.All of these elements led me to a situation where although I really longed for someone to love me, but I will reject those around me at the same time. It’s actually really painful.When I first started composing, it was a way to relieve my feelingsStaying in my own room, crazily playing the piano and singing on and on.It felt good.But all my venting, I won’t let others listen to it.Because I’ve experienced it first hand, this self-contradiction, the self-struggle.I want to use my feelings at that time to express the emotions of the song. I can resonate with the lyrics of the song a lot, so I was in pain when rearranging this song, because I had to constantly recallthe unpleasant memories from before.I added a lot of shouts and screams, and the audience might feel slightly uncomfortable when they hear it. But the screaming represents the final struggles.Since there was no one cared for me, I needed to save myself.This singer told me that this way of expressing.But thankfully I was very lucky, and I received a lot of love later onsuch that I was able to jump out of that environment.So I used a reversed way to let the audience to attention to those around them in the same situation.You need to try and understand them.In their hearts, they might need someone to love them and care for them. 2. posts.text: Hua Chenyu sang an adapted version of independent musician Chen Li’s masterpiece “Flammable and Explosive (易燃易爆炸)” on the singing competition “The Next S1“ EP9 in 2016 and on the singing contest “Singer 2018“ EP8 in March, 2018. 1. About the songThe first time Hua Chenyu covered this song was at “Mars Concert 2016“ in Beijing. Since Hua already had cover experience, he found it not difficult when this song was selected as the designated track for EP9 of “The Next S1“. But during rehearsal, the director asked him to add coloratura to the interlude. As a result, although Hua said that he had never sung coloratura before and might not be good at it, he quickly mastered the coloratura skills. In the “Singer 2018” EP8, Hua Chenyu suddenly learned the news of the death of lyricist Shang Mengdi during rehearsal, so he urgently abandoned the rehearsed song and changed it to this song “Flammable and Explosive”. Although there was no time to rehearse, so the previous arrangement was almost copied completely, but the emotional explosion brought a strong auditory and visual shock to the audience. 2. posts.title: Us (我们)

posts.title: I am What I am (我)
posts.text: On April 6, 2018, Hua Chenyu sang the late Asian superstar Leslie Cheung’s masterpiece “I am What I am (我)” in the singing contest “Singer 2018“ EP12. 1. About the songHua Chenyu sang “I am What I am” for the first time in his debut show “Superboy 2013“ and entered the top 9, eventually winning the championship. After that, on the last day of his annual Mars Concert, Hua Chenyu would sing this song as an encore song for his fans. The reason is that this, his favorite song, is a profound representation of what it means to be a human being. In “Singer 2018“, Hua Chenyu performed this song on a stage other than his personal concert for the first time since his debut. In order to pay tribute to Leslie Cheung, he appeared on stage in pajamas and made no changes to the arrangement. 2. Videos“Singer 2018” EP12 “Superboy 2013” TOP10 to TOP9 3. posts.title: “Singer 2018” - Singing Talent Show Contest
posts.text: In February 2018, Hua Chenyu participated in Hunan TV’s singing talent show contest “Singer 2018” as a filled-in contestant. Hua fought until the finals and won second place. 1. About the showAccording to the regulations, each contestant can only sing up to 3 of his original songs. In other words, they mainly have to perform cover songs. Therefore, the two problems of the contest are how to choose the songs and how to rearrange the songs.The performance will be evaluated by the 500 audience members of the public audience at the venue. Audience members was selected strictly and equally from each age group via a questionnaire, and in theory, contestant’ fans are prohibited from being selected.Every year, the final winner receives the title of “King of Singers”. 2. Playlist“Singer 2018” Full Version (Only for Channel’s M2VIP Menber):https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUM8x224JrX9s65DIWbPGliUwfm23KlMN Hua’s Performances:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tb2NMFnbfoY 3. Detailed information about each episodeEP4 (first appearance)February 2, 2018Repertoire: Qi Tian (齐天)Original Singer: Hua ChenyuRanking: 1 This is his first appearance as a filled-in contestant! Ended Jessie J’s winning streak.Received a Flowers With Smiley Faces badge (Takashi Murakami) presented by his exclusive MC Li Weijia. Hua have been wearing it on his chest ever since! EP5February 9, 2018Repertoire: Child (孩子)Ranking: 3Original Singer: Xi Lou (Composer of Hua’s original song”Ashes from Fireworks (烟火里的尘埃)“) Added the melody of “Ashes from Fireworks (烟火里的尘埃)“to the interlude. EP6February 16, 2018Repertoire: Nunchucks (双截棍)Original Singer: Jay ChouRanking: 1 The broadcast date of EP6 happens to be the first day of the Chinese Lunar New Year. EP7February 23, 2018Repertoire: I Don’t Care (我管你)Original Singer: Hua ChenyuRanking: 1 This time was a Re-Mix version that emphasized the bass in the intro. EP8March 9, 2018Repertoire: Flammable and Explosive (易燃易爆炸)Original Singer: Chen LiRanking: 3 During the rehearsal, Hua suddenly learned of the death of Lyricist Shang Mengdi, and he changed his scheduled performance to this song at the last minute.However, due to the program’s self-regulation, several parts of the lyrics were changed. EP9March 16, 2018Repertoire: WayfarerOriginal Singer: No Party For Cao DongRanking: 5 A controversial adaptation. Obtained the lowest personal ranking since participating in the program. EP10March 23, 2018Repertoire: Fake Monk (假行僧)Original Singer: Cui JianRanking: 2 An experimental-voice music using just one piano. EP11March 30, 2018Repertoire: The Ordinary Path (平凡之路)Original Singer: Pu ShuRanking: 2 Hua added the melody of his original song “Mayfly (蜉蝣)“ by humming it.This is Hua’s first time trying long hair styling. EP12April 6, 2018Repertoire: I Am What I Am (我)Original Singer: Leslie CheungRanking: 1 A song that has a special meaning for Hua and that he only has the strength to sing it once a year. EP13 FinalsApril 13, 2018 Round 1Repertoire: Light Years Away (光年之外)Support Guest & Original Singer: G.E.M.Ranking: Reached the Round 2 Round 2Repertoire: Shouts (呐喊)Original Singer: Angela ZhangRanking: Runner-up This song has been rearranged in a completely different style from the original version.Later, Hua was able to create a new original work based on this song, namely “New World“, the title song of his 4th album. After-partyApril 20, 2018Repertoire: Glimmer (微光)Original Singer: Hua Chenyu Because Hua didn’t know that there was a live broadcast camera set up backstage, he accidentally said that, his track had been changed by the program in the last-minute before going on stage. This conversation was edited out during the replay.The song performed during the rehearsal was “somebody that I used to know” Live broadcast of After-party’s backstage

posts.title: Wayfarer (山海)
posts.text: On March 16, 2018, Hua Chenyu performed a subversive adaptation of the Taiwanese indie band No Party For Cao Dong’s masterpiece “Wayfarer (山海)” on the singing contest “Singer 2018“ EP9. 1. About the song The original song brings negative emotions to the audience, expressing the regret and anger of young people who are in conflict with life for the first time. However, Hua Chenyu, wrapped in a red raincoat that is more dazzling than the flames, added layer-by-layer passionate melody and guitar solo from bass to treble to the song, giving the song a new interpretation and vitality. That is the voice of people who remain unwavering in the face of difficulties and still hold on to a glimmer of hope in desperate plight. However, the audience’s likes and dislikes of subversive adaptations were polarized. The song only ranked 5th, which was his lowest ranking since participating in the show. Later, he adapted the song again at the Mars Concert 2023, removing the rap that was mainly used to incite the audience’s emotions, and using a more magnificent chorus and accompaniment to complete an interpretation that was more in line with his personal aesthetics. 2.
