posts.title: 2025 Event information
posts.text: Event information other than personal concerts. Including live events such as music festivals and gala performances on TV. Click here for event information from past years: ③ Live: - ₂ Events JanuaryHunan TV Countdown PartyJanuary 1Venue: Haikou - Wuyuan River Stadium Hua Chenyu participated in Hunan TV’s countdown party for 12 consecutive years.This year, Hua performed two new songs, “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology (怪诞心理学)“ and “In the Morning Light, There’s You (晨光你有你)“, which were first released at the “Mars Concert 2024“.In addition, Hua and Idol group TNT (时代少年团) together performed the song “我要你管”, a mix of their respective masterpieces “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ and “要你管”. “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology (怪诞心理学)“ “In the Morning Light, There’s You (晨光你有你)“ FanCam “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ Mix. “要你管 (TNT)” Official Video vlog Hunan TV Spring Festival GalaJanuary 23Venue: Changsha - Hunan Radio and Television Program Production Base Hua performed “In the Morning Light, There’s You (晨光你有你)“, a new song from his newly released 6th album “Quantitative Change Tipping Point“. “In the Morning Light, There’s You (晨光你有你)“ Official Video Backstage interview AprilBeloong Music Festival, WuhangApril 20Venue: Wuhan - INTIME Music Park After six years, on April 20, Hua Chenyu returned to the music festival stage! With his full concert band lineup and brand-new VJ animations specially created for the festival. Hua delivered six songs to his hometown audience in Wuhan. The setlist included fan-dubbed “commercial performance package” like “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ and “For Forever“, alongside recent releases “Black and White Artist“, “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology“, “Extraordinary Ordinary Life“, and “Never Cross Paths AKA Eternal Farewell “, culminating with the classic Martian love ballad “King and Beggar“.Notably, “Black and White Artist“ marked its debut performance outside Hua’s solo concerts. “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ “Black and White Artist (黑白艺术家)“ “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology (怪诞心理学)“ “Extraordinary Ordinary Life (普通到不普通的人生)“ “Never Cross Paths AKA Eternal Farewell (不重逢)“ “For Forever“ “King and Beggar (国王与乞丐)“ FanCam MayChangchun Aura Music FestivalMay 25Venue: Changchun - Olympic Park On May 25, Hua Chenyu performed at the Aura Music Festival in Changchun. This marked his first live performance in China’s northeastern region and served as a warm-up for his upcoming Mars Concert in the northeastern city of Shenyang next month.After last weekend’s Mars Concert in Qingdao, Hua caught a cold, so he performed at this festival while under the weather. He could be seen occasionally covering his microphone to cough quietly, but he still maintained a high vocal standard, delivering a total of 8 songs – one more than at last month’s music festival in Wuhan! “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ “Black and White Artist (黑白艺术家)“ “Extraordinary Ordinary Life (普通到不普通的人生)“ “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology (怪诞心理学)“ “Never Cross Paths AKA Eternal Farewell (不重逢)“ “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End (点燃银河尽头的篝火)“ “For Forever“ “King and Beggar (国王与乞丐)“ FanCam JulyZhangbei Grassland Music FestivalJuly 26Venue: Zhangjiakou - Zhangbei Zhongdu Original Grassland On July 26, Hua Chenyu visited Hebei Province, to participate in the Zhangbei Grassland Music Festival. On Zhangbei Grassland, rare consecutive heavy rains hit the drought-stricken grassland, turning the lawn into a pond deeper than the calf. The environment was extremely harsh.Equipment was damaged by the rain, making rehearsals impossible. After taking the stage, Hua and the band members found their in-ear monitors silent – only the metronome worked. So they sang three songs along with only the metronome. The accompaniment that followed was also intermittent, but it did not affect his performance at all.Braving the rain, Hua Chenyu stated that he took the stage in his casual clothes, as fans had wished during the live stream. Coincidentally, this entire outfit – from head to toe – was waterproof.The setlist included “Searching for Myself (好想我回来啊)“, a song that had never been performed at a festival before. “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ “Black and White Artist (黑白艺术家)“ “Extraordinary Ordinary Life (普通到不普通的人生)“ “Searching for Myself (好想我回来啊)“ “Never Cross Paths AKA Eternal Farewell (不重逢)“ “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End (点燃银河尽头的篝火)“ “King and Beggar (国王与乞丐)“ FanCam AugustZ Era Galaxy Left Bank Music FestivalAugust 3Venue: Guiyang - Guanshan Lake Park On August 3, Hua Chenyu returned to Guiyang Guanshan Lake Park, where he held a Theme Park-style Concert just last year, to participate in the Z Era Galaxy Left Bank Music Festival.Hua wore casual clothes again this time, with snow-white hair. What’s more, he put on the red sunglasses that he couldn’t wear at the previous music festival due to heavy rain.Hua also arranged for drones to perform in coordination with his performance. “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ “Black and White Artist (黑白艺术家)“ “Extraordinary Ordinary Life (普通到不普通的人生)“ “Never Cross Paths AKA Eternal Farewell (不重逢)“ “I’m Here AKA I Really Want to Love This World (好想爱这个世界啊)“ “For Forever“ “King and Beggar (国王与乞丐)“ FanCam PEACE NIGHT of “Game For Peace”August 9Venue: Sanya - Egret Stadium, Sanya Sports Center On August 9, Hua Chenyu participated as a celebrity endorsement in the “PEACE NIGHT” of the mobile game “Game For Peace”.All four celebrity endorsements of “Game For Peace” (Hua Chenyu, Victoria Song, Tian Xiwei, Esther Yu) appeared in cosplay. Hua cosplayed the character “Nova Fierce Loong (新星烈龙)” (wearing the headpiece of “Fantasy Rocket (梦幻火箭)”).In addition to the 5th Anniversary Theme Song “Eternal Flame AKA The onquenchable fire (永不熄灭的火焰)“, Hua also performed his original song “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology (怪诞心理学)“.In the exhibition match, Hua led his team to victory. “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology (怪诞心理学)“ “Eternal Flame AKA The onquenchable fire (永不熄灭的火焰)“ Official Video Tencent Video JUMPPARK Music FestivalAugust 16Venue: Qingdao - the tarmac of the closed former Liuting Airport On August 16, Tencent Video JUMPPARK Music Festival was held at the tarmac of Qingdao’s former Liuting Airport. Hua Chenyu closed the event with 8 of his representative songs.Hua Chenyu appeared with silvery-white long hair, paired with avant-garde stage costumes. He took the stage on a suspended extended platform to perform, creating a mysterious atmosphere where “the voice can be heard but the person cannot be seen”, and the footage shot from an overhead angle stunned the entire audience.Hua redesigned the opening music for this music festival. The stage design integrated laser effects, drone performances, and spraying of ribbon paper, and also adopted the visual logo of his Mars Concert, thus creating an immersive “mini Mars Concert” experience. Hua Chenyu asked the fans on site, “Did you see the surprise?” “Illusion and Reality (虚幻与现实)“ “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ “Black and White Artist (黑白艺术家)“ “Never Cross Paths AKA Eternal Farewell (不重逢)“ “Searching for Myself (好想我回来啊)“ “King and Beggar (国王与乞丐)“ “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End (点燃银河尽头的篝火)“ “Growing Toward the Sun (向阳而生)“ FanCam September“Follow the Singers to Huaihua” ConcertSeptember 20Venue: Huaihua Sports Center Main Stadium On September 20, 2025, the “Follow the Singers to Huaihua” Concert, part of the 5th Tourism Development Conference of Hunan Province, was held in Huaihua City. The entire concert was live-streamed on Mango TV and aired on Hunan Satellite TV the next day.The concert pioneered an interactive segment called “Travel Blind Box”. Hua Chenyu opened the “Gourmet Emoji Blind Box” and showcased a variety of Huaihua’s specialty dishes through “audio scenes + visual symbols”. The on-site audience guessed the dish names while listening to the music, and those who guessed correctly could redeem a physical blind box.The stage design for “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology (怪诞心理学)“ was extremely bizarre. A group of backup dancers each held up huge portraits of Hua and danced around him. During the final chorus, the dancers even lifted Hua horizontally above their shoulders, allowing him to lie on top of the crowd and sing. “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology (怪诞心理学)“ “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End (点燃银河尽头的篝火)“ “Beauty Yet Revealed to Me (那些我尚未知道的美丽)“ Official Video Bubbling&Boiling Music&Arts FestivalSeptember 21Venue: Foshan - Foshan Grassland Music Venue On September 21, 2025, Hua Chenyu returned to Foshan to perform at the Bubbling&Boiling Music&Arts Festival, following his solo concert during the May Day holiday.Hua Chenyu took the stage wearing a simple striped T-shirt and jeans. The T-shirt was very similar to the one he wore at the Shanghai Zebra Music Festival in 2018, and the jeans have also been a favorite item that has frequently appeared in private settings such as rehearsal photos since 2018. This outfit evoked memories for the fans.Additionally, this was also the first time Hua performed “Eternal Flame (永不熄灭的火焰)“ at a music festival. “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ “Black and White Artist (黑白艺术家)“ “Eternal Flame (永不熄灭的火焰)“ “Never Cross Paths AKA Eternal Farewell (不重逢)“ “Searching for Myself (好想我回来啊)“ “For Forever“ “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End (点燃银河尽头的篝火)“ “King and Beggar (国王与乞丐)“ FanCam OctoberMount Emei Funfunfly Music FestivalOctober 25Venue: Emeishan City - Exiu Lake Music Camp Mount Emei, which towers in the southwest of Chengdu, China, has long been regarded as the Four Sacred Buddhist Mountains of China.Mount Emei Funfunfly Music Festival was held on the shores of Exiu Lake, located at the eastern foot of Mount Emei. Hua Chenyu made a stunning appearance with punk rock makeup and platinum-blonde long hair, and sang 7 songs in the rain. “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ “Black and White Artist (黑白艺术家)“ “Eternal Flame (永不熄灭的火焰)“ “Never Cross Paths AKA Eternal Farewell (不重逢)“ “For Forever“ “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End (点燃银河尽头的篝火)“ “King and Beggar (国王与乞丐)“ FanCam NovemberWeibo Bigeye Music FestivalNovember 10Venue: Nanjing - Gucheng Lake Water Slow City A music festival hosted by Weibo, China’s largest social media platform.Hua Chenyu showed off his platinum-blonde long hair again, pairing an all-black outfit with black leather gloves and black sunglasses. Holding a white microphone, he exuded intense visual tension in the rain.This music festival was a schedule that had been announced early at Hua Chenyu’s Nanjing Concerts during the weeklong National Day holiday. At the music festival, a promotional video for his upcoming Mars Concerts to be held at the Wenchang International Aerospace City at the end of this month was also played. “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ “Black and White Artist (黑白艺术家)“ “Never Cross Paths AKA Eternal Farewell (不重逢)“ “Searching for Myself (好想我回来啊)“ “I’m Here AKA I Really Want to Love This World (好想爱这个世界啊)“ “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End (点燃银河尽头的篝火)“ “For Forever“ “King and Beggar (国王与乞丐)“ FanCam Oxygen Music FestivalNovember 15Venue: Hangzhou - Grand Canal Hanggang Park Hua Chenyu took the stage with his natural hair for the first time in a long while. His fluffy curly hair adorned with a few simple hair clips created an adorable look that drew constant screams from the audience.The temperature was low that day. Hua Chenyu wore a windproof jacket with contrasting colors of red, yellow, and blue, occasionally pulling up the collar or tucking his hands into the opposite sleeves. However, the powerful explosive energy of his songs quickly ignited the atmosphere at the venue. “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ “Black and White Artist (黑白艺术家)“ “Eternal Flame AKA The onquenchable fire (永不熄灭的火焰)“ “Never Cross Paths AKA Eternal Farewell (不重逢)“ “Searching for Myself (好想我回来啊)“ “For Forever“ “King and Beggar (国王与乞丐)“ Oasisplan Music FestivalNovember 16Venue: Suzhou - Huanxiu Lake Music Park To let Hua Chenyu participate in the weekly live stream of a variety show, the program team and the music festival organizers held lengthy negotiations. Two days before the music festival, they temporarily decided to change Hua Chenyu’s stage time from the closing act to the opening act. As compensation for the audience who had purchased tickets in advance, Hua sang one extra song. “I Don’t Care (我管你)“ “Black and White Artist (黑白艺术家)“ “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology (怪诞心理学)“ “Eternal Flame AKA The onquenchable fire (永不熄灭的火焰)“ “Never Cross Paths AKA Eternal Farewell (不重逢)“ “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End (点燃银河尽头的篝火)“ “For Forever“ “King and Beggar (国王与乞丐)“

posts.title: MARS CONCERT 2024
posts.text: Time Location Guest May 1-2, 4 Libeng Island Beach, Yantai Zuo Li May 24-26 Central Harbourfront Event Space,Hong Kong Zuo Li July 20-21 International Sports Center,Nanchang Aug 10-11 Olympic Sports Center Stadium,Hefei Aug 24 Olympic Sports Center Stadium,Chongqing Sept 7-8 National Stadium (Bird’s Nest), Beijing Oct 4-6 Guanshan Lake Park, Guiyang Zuo LiNing Huanyu (impromptu) Oct 26 Olympic Sports Center Stadium(Big Lotus), Hangzhou Nov 10 Wuhan Five Rings Sports Center Stadium Nov 29-30 Universiade Sports Centre Stadium,Shenzhen » Ticket Purchase Guide « 1. Achievements After 3 years, Hua Chenyu finally fulfilled his promise to hold a concert where he can watch the sunrise with his fans! The world’s first solo concert specifically be held in the early morning to greet the sunrise. Fortunately, after several days of cloudy weather, everyone finally saw the sunrise! The stage design had been significantly upgraded based on last year’s design, and the music team had also been replaced. Producer Bernard Zheng, who has collaborated with Hua since his debut, served as music director and added new arrangements to half of Hua’s songs. Teachers and students from the China Academy of Art designed an installation art exhibition for the concert. On June 2, a re-recording album “Sunrise Concert Speciel Album“ including 8 rearranged tracks selected from the Sunrise Concert, was released. Breaking records for the largest audience in a single concert at stadiums in various cities. The Sunrise Concert’s stage design won the Platinum Award at the MUSE Design Awards in 2024; and the lighting design of four-sided stage won the Lighting Design of the Year in 2025. » Poster and Stage Design Photo Gallery « 2. Anecdote For the Sunrise Concert in Yantai, tens of thousands of fans who couldn’t buy tickets gathered on the beach and lawns outside the venue all night. Organizers set up special safe viewing areas on the beach, added speakers, and even opened the entrance to let outside fans in for the final few songs before the concert ended. When holding a stadium concert, Hua always rents out a shopping mall atrium in the city to open a pop-up store and sell peripheral goods and snacks. A different sentence was printed each day on the long ribbon paper that was sprayed at the end of the performance. However, on the first day in Hong Kong, the spraying equipment was damaged by rain and the long ribbon paper could not be released. Translation Original Yantai Day 1 Martians, welcome home!Yantai, here we come! 火星人，欢迎回家！烟台，我们来了！ Day 2 Toss away all your worries!Enjoy every minute and second! 把烦恼都甩掉吧！享受每分每秒！ Day 3 - Red Let’s go and watch the sunrise! 走！一起去看日出吧！ Day 3 - Golden Don’t cry, you are forever my sun 别哭，你永远是我的太阳 Hong Kong Day 2 Do not yield to reality,on this battlefield! 别向现实投降，在这个战场！ Day 3 It’s sunrise, give the world a hug! 日出，给世界一个拥抱！ Nanchang Day 1 The sea of time swallows me whole 时间之海 将我掩埋 Day 2 Renewing and reloading the soul 更换灵魂 再装载 Hefei Day 1 Martians, Happy Qixi Festival！ (Chinese Valentine’s Day) 火星人，七夕快乐！ Day 2 oho～ for forever～ oho～ for forever～ Chongqing Take off the top hat and laugh out loudThe atmosphere is just right, 脱掉礼帽 大笑 这气氛刚刚好 Beijing Freeze the happiness from the “Bird’s Nest”,and keep the memory forever! “鸟巢”快乐定格，让记忆长存！ Life bestows splendor,Life bestows hopeLife bestows transience to all existence 生予绚烂，生予希望，生予一切无常！ Guiyang Day 1 Long to see a universe filled with stars 想看 装满星星的宇宙 Day 2 As long as I sleep in my warm houseI still have everything 睡在我的温暖房子我就还拥有所有 Day 3 Grids of warm lights, one by one; Rows of good children, one by one 好的灯火 一格一格；好孩子 一个一个 Hangzhou But darling, we’ll soon, soon reunite 宝贝我们会很快 很快就能再相守 Wuhan We only love after regret settles in 我们都 遗憾过 才会爱 Shenzhen Day 1 Do you still remember the agreementfive years ago? 还记得五年前 的约定吗？ Day 2 Enjoying a fleeting moment of freedomSee you next year! 享受片刻的自由明年见！ Yantai Concert This time, Hua’s personal concert still took the form of a rock festival, and was held for three consecutive days (in the evenings of May 1-2 and early morning of May 4) in the beautiful coastal city of Yantai in eastern China. The concert on the third day was held from 3:00 am to 6:00 am, and more than 100,000 people greeted the sunrise while singing “Growing Toward the Sun (向阳而生)“! Wang Ye, an online self-media operator who specializes in analyzing the equipment and costs of various concerts, followed and filmed a micro-documentary of the Sunrise Concert. » Yantai Concert Photo Gallery « Hong Kong Concert This was Hua’s first personal concert outside mainland China. The concert still took the form of a rock festival, and was held for three consecutive days (May 24-26) at the Central Harbourfront Event Space, facing the Victoria Harbour. After 2021, the Mars Concert was finally able to set off fireworks again. And in the stage design of some songs (“God Tree“, “Bullfight“), Smoke Fog Jets were replaced by flame-throwing effect. Hua sang the full version of “I am What I am“ (not just a section in the Cover Songs Medley) at his personal concert after a long absence. This was considered a tribute to Leslie Cheung at the place where he died. » Hong Kong Concert Photo Gallery « Nanchang Concert On July 20-21, Hua Chenyu continued his live tour in Nanchang, the capital city of Jiangxi Province, China. For the first performance of the second half of the year, a new four-sided stage design was unveiled, and a completely different setlist was arranged from the rock theme park-style concerts. It was also the first time that Hua sang all his own songs without singing any cover songs. In order to sing more songs, Hua arranged a rock song medley and a fan favorite song medley. A new song will be released in each city in the second half of the year. This time in Nanchang, Hua debuted his new song “Ship of Theseus (忒修斯的船)“. As the weather was extremely hot, a full range of cooling measures were taken. The outdoor air-conditioning fans that were urgently purchased at the Wuhan Concert last year were not used in Changsha due to the rain, but this time they finally came in handy again, spraying cold water mist on the arena all the time before the show started. At the entrance to each block of stand seats, ice buckets were placed to wipe and cool the body. In addition, cooling pads, cooling wipes and menthol balm were distributed free of charge to all audience members. Hua almost got heatstroke while singing on the first day, so in the second half of Day2, he appeared on stage wearing a ice vest that he had worn during rehearsal. » Nanchang Concert Photo Gallery « Hefei Concert On August 10-11, Hua Chenyu continued his live tour in Hefei, the capital city of Anhui Province, China. A new song will be released in each city in the second half of the year. This time, Hua debuted his new song “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology (怪诞心理学)“. August 10 is the “Qixi Festival”, which is the Chinese Valentine’s Day based on the romantic legend of the Zhinü and Niulang. As a surprise, Hua gifted each audience with a pack of flower seeds. In addition, the pop-up store sold limited-time snacks (pink soft drinks, red butterfly pastry sets, and flower tea sets). During “Sea of Wind“ on August 10, the big screen showed the most affectionate conversation that Hua and his fans have had in years. From the handwriting, fans inferred that the words shown on the big screen were written by Hua himself. On the 11, while singing the last few sentences of “I’m Here AKAI Really Want toLove This World“, Hua squatted down and appeared to be unwell. After the concert, He posted on Weibo: “I’m fine, don’t worry, see you in Chongqing! (我没事，放心吧，我们重庆见！)” » Hefei Concert Photo Gallery « Chongqing Concert On August 24, Hua Chenyu continued his live tour in Chongqing city. On that day, the temperature in Chongqing reached 42 degrees Celsius. In addition to cooling pads and cooling wipes, Huoxiang Zhengqi Shui (a traditional Chinese medicine drink for treating heatstroke) and drinking water were also provided free of charge. A new song will be released in each city in the second half of the year. This time, Hua debuted his new song “Warm House (温暖的房子)“. » Chongqing Concert Photo Gallery « Beijing (Bird’s Nest) Concert On September 7-8, Hua Chenyu performed at the National Stadium (Bird’s Nest) for the third time. September 8 marks the sixth anniversary of Hua’s first personal concert at the Bird’s Nest. As a commemoration, Hua Chenyu sent physical gifts by courier to all the audience members who purchased tickets through official channels. The gifts include perfumes, scented candles, sachets, hand creams and a variety of T-shirts. The gifts were designed by artist Song Santu and were also exhibited as part of an installation art piece at Mars Concert 2023. At the end of the set list, “Growing Toward the Sun - Sunrise Ver.“ was sung, recreating the grand occasion of the Sunrise Concert. A new song will be released in each city in the second half of the year. This time, Hua debuted his new song Never Cross Paths (不重逢)“. Wang Ye filmed his second micro-documentary for Mars Concert. » Beijing (Bird's Nest) Concert Photo Gallery « Guiyang Concert On October 4-6, Hua Chenyu held his last rock festival-style concert of this year for three consecutive days in Guiyang City, Guizhou Province, southwest China. Fireworks were allowed at the venue, and not only were fireworks set off during the last song, but also during the song “Eternal Flame“, several sophisticated rocket-shaped fireworks were set off. At the Matinee, high-pressure fountain mist containing perfume was sprayed on the audience. Guiyang is located in a hilly area with an average altitude of more than 1,000 meters. In autumn, the temperature drops, and Hua feels discomfort in his throat due to the rapid inhalation of a large amount of air when singing. So, he changed his habit of rarely drinking water during performances and began to drink hot water frequently on stage. At the Matinee on the third day, Hua impromptu pulled his friend Ning Huanyu, whom he met on his debut show “Superboy 2013“, from the audience to the stage, and together with Zuo Li, the three of them sang “Follow Me“, a collaborative song composed by Ning. » Guiyang Concert Photo Gallery « Hangzhou (Big Lotus) Concert On August 24, Hua Chenyu continued his live tour in Hangzhou. Hangzhou’s newly built “Big Lotus” Stadium is second only to Beijing’s Bird’s Nest in terms of area. The audience for this concert exceeded 80,000 people. A new song will be released in each city in the second half of the year. This time, Hua debuted his new song “Human’s Love (人之爱)“. Taking the stage with a long-lost short hairstyle On the evening before the concert, Hua live-streamed himself touring the stadium. It was the first time for him to personally watch the stage effects from the various levels of the stands, and he said it was much more beautiful and spectacular than what he could see on the stage. During the concert, Hua recalled the Hangzhou stop of the “Superboy 2013“ live tour which he took part in shortly after his debut, and impromptu sang a few lines of “Mr. Almost (差不多先生)”, which he sang back then. » Hangzhou Concert Photo Gallery « Wuhan Concert On November 10, Hua Chenyu continued his live tour in his hometown of Wuhan. The opening song was changed to “You Have To Believe This Is Not the Last Day (你要相信这不是最后一天)“, a charity song Hua wrote to support the citizens of Wuhan who have been severely hurt by COVID 19. Wuhan is known as the “Breakfast Capital” of China because of the variety of breakfast options available, and eating breakfast is called “passing breakfast (过早)” in local dialect. On November 7, Hua rode a shared bike alone early in the morning, had breakfast (hot dry noodles, bean curd skin, eggnog), and broadcast the whole thing live on his mobile phone. The day after the concert, Hua Chenyu strolled to the popular check-in spot on Mars where a large number of fans gathered - Wuhan Conservatory of Music (Hua’s alma mater), and lined up with fans to buy the dessert that became popular because of his own favorite. » Wuhan Concert Photo Gallery « Shenzhen Concert On November 29-30, Hua Chenyu held the final concert of this year’s tour in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province. The Mars Concert 2019 held in Haikou was originally scheduled to be held in Shenzhen, and tickets were already sold out, but it was canceled due to force majeure. This year, Hua Chenyu finally fulfilled the promise he made to Shenzhen five years ago. For the promotional poster, Hua also chose to use the 2019 version. A new song will be released in each city in the second half of the year. This time, Hua debuted the last new song “In the Morning Light, There’s You (晨光里有你)“. The word “晨光” in the song title means “morning light” and includes the same Chinese character as “晨” in Hua Chenyu’s name, so the song title can also be interpreted as “Hua Chenyu, in the light, there’s you.” The design of the Rock Theme Park-Style concerts (Guiyang Concert) was transplanted to the stadium, achieving rocket-shaped fireworks and high-pressure fountain mist spraying. On the night before the concert, Hua held a live broadcast on SNS with the theme of “Mars Year-End Party”. Wearing a black suit, Hua imitated the style of a company boss while summarizing this year’s live tour and sharing many anecdotes related to the concerts. » Shenzhen Concert Photo Gallery « 3. posts.title: MARS CONCERT 2025
posts.text: Time Location Guest March 8-9 Strait Olympic Sports Center,Fuzhou March 22-23 Helong Sports Center,Changsha April 5-6 Xi’an Olympic Sports Center May 2-4 Qiandeng Lake Music Show Venue,Foshan Zuo Li May 17 Qingdao Citizen Fitness Center Stadium May 31-June 1 Chengdu Dong’an LakeSports Park Stadium June 14 Zhengzhou Olympic Sports Center June 28 Shenyang Olympic Sports Center Aug. 29-31 Suzhou Olympic Sports Center Oct. 4-6 Nanjing Tangshan Music Valley Zuo Li Nov. 28-30 Haikou Changying Wonderland Zuo Li Jan. 2, 2026 Guangxi Sports Center Stadium,Nanning Feb. 6-8 Shenzhen UniversiadeSports Centre Stadium » Ticket Purchase Guide « 1. Achievements This year, Hua Chenyu has completely updated the setlist and arrangements. The arrangement theme is “East-West Fusion,” skillfully blending traditional Chinese instruments such as guzheng, xiao, and pipa with Western instruments like harp, Scottish bagpipes, and Irish flutes. Through the collision of Eastern and Western musical elements and cross-cultural art fusion, he has expanded his musical boundaries anew. May 4 is the first anniversary of the sunrise concert. 2,000 drones were launched to simulate the sun and spell out the words: “You are my sun — by Big Brother. (你们就是我的太阳 ——大哥)”, setting a record for the number of drones launched above the concert venue. (Due to the large gathering of people at the performance site, for safety reasons, the launch of such a large number of drones is usually not allowed.) During the Foshan concerts, the fans ate a total of 3 tons of rice in three days (“Chenyu Fried Rice” was distributed for free, each fan could line up multiple times to receive a 50ml cup-sized serving). On February 7, 2026, at the concert venue celebrating Hua Chenyu’s 36th birthday, the audience spontaneously organized across various viewing sections to create a spectacular giant mosaic. By raising different colored fluorescent boards, they formed massive characters that illuminated the night. » Poster and Stage Design Photo Gallery « 2. Anecdote Hua Chenyu opened the performance by singing the Baroque rock-style song “Illusion and Reality“ while descending from mid-air on a spiral-shaped lift stage fully decorated with diamonds. The hit song “Ashes from Fireworks“ from Hua’s debut album “Quasimodo’s Gift“ was composed by indie musician Xilou. Hua Chenyu stated during his cover of Xilou’s representative work “Child“ on “Singer 2018“ that “Ashes from Fireworks“ could be seen as a prelude to “Child“. He masterfully fused the harmonies of both songs, finally presenting them in mashup format this time. Similarly, Hua mashed up two songs - “Extraordinary Ordinary Life“ and “Beauty Yet Revealed to Me“. Originally twin tracks sharing the same melody with different lyrical themes and arrangements, they were remixed under the new title “From Ordinary to Beauty Yet Revealed” and incorporated into the medley segment. On the second day of the Foshan concerts, there was a heavy rain. But the heavy rain didn’t dampen the fans’ enthusiasm – many of them started playing in the rain, which eased Hua’s worries about everyone. Also, during the Foshan concerts, the fans ate a total of 3 tons of rice in three days (“Chenyu Fried Rice” was distributed for free, each fan could line up multiple times to receive a 50ml cup-sized serving). Hua Chenyu engaged in “weather-based bet” with fans during concerts in various cities. This was a plan inspired by his “Little Sun” legend (believed to bring sunshine to concert dates). It was decided that if it rained, Hua would win, and if it was sunny, the fans would win, with both sides experiencing victories and defeats. As punishment, Hua danced to the choreography from the “Bizarre Psychology AKAQuirky Psychology“ MV in Xi’an. Later, in Qingdao, he proposed and fulfilled a reward of enjoying the sight of fans singing from the audience while eating and drinking on stage. The concert held on February 7th (Hua’s 36th birthday), marked the first public birthday celebration Hua has held since his debut. A different sentence was printed each day on the long ribbon paper that was sprayed at the end of the performance. Translation Original Fuzhou Day 1 As dawn embraces this tranquil cityMartians, welcome home! 当晨曦拥抱这座城火星人 欢迎回家！ Day 2 In this morning glowlet my dream last forever 在这晨光中做一场不落幕的美梦！ Changsha Day 1 Anchor here in this harborSeize the moment, and call it eternity! 停泊在这港口握住一瞬间 称它为永久！ Day 2 That’s why I await each monsoonin this world full of temptations 才期待 花花世界每一场季风！ Xi'an Day 1 Let love flow hand to handblooming with life 将爱掌心传递随 生命绽放！ Day 2 Laugh to your heart’s content Cry like no one else judgesWhy should my expressions Be arranged by the world 笑得开怀 哭得坦率为何表情要让这世界安排！ Foshan Day 1 Let’s all togetherwildly unleash our youth, shall we! 我们所有人一起肆意挥洒我们的青春 好不好！ Day 2 Warm each other, shine on each otherI believe this is the meaning of Mars’ existence! 温暖彼此 照耀彼此我觉得这就是火星存在的意义！ Day 3 We did itTogether, we sang the sun out! 我们做到了我们一起把太阳唱出来了 Qingdao Sing! The inch of pure land in our souls! 歌唱 我们灵魂中的那一寸净土！ Chengdu Day 1 You all look stunning tonight! 你们今晚 太美啦！ Day 2 Director, cut to me, cut to me! 导播，切我，切我！ Zhengzhou / / Shenyang Treat everything with kindness even if they are not mine 善待所有 哪怕不属于我 Suzhou Day 1 Too much paraded into my realmin the name of love! 太多爱的名义奔赴在我的领地！ Day 2 All things bloomwith a single move of my thoughts! 万物皆只因我一念花开！ Day 3 Follow me Follow me Follow meand scream at the top of your lungs! 跟着我 跟着我跟着我大声地尖叫！ Nanjing Day 1 Accompany you, Embrace youGive a meaning to your efforts 陪伴你 拥抱你 给予你努力的意义！ Day 2 It is worthwhile to cherish the countless people whom you have missed and metand the flowers that have bloomed and fallen 值得珍惜 无数擦肩无数相见花开与花落 Day 3 Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! 中秋 快乐！ Haikou Day 1 The prelude of the “Magnificent (Hua)” Chapter is Warm Spring and Flowers Bloom “华”章起笔是春暖花开 Day 2 “Morning (Chen)” Light writes the sequel as a seaside sunrise “晨”光续写为海边日出 Day 3 Spend this fleeting lights of now with “You (Yu)” “宇”你共度此刻限定的“光” Nanning Happy New Year 2026! 2026 新年快乐！ Shenzhen Day 1 All unknowns will pass by you 一切未知的也只是经过 Day 2 Happy Birthday on Mars! 在火星 生日快乐！ Day 3 Martian Flowers Blooming 2.0. Catch you on Mars! 火星花盛开2.0 火星见！ Fuzhou On March 8-9, Hua Chenyu launched his annual tour with two consecutive concerts in Fuzhou, the capital of Fujian Province in southern China. The March 8 premiere coincided with International Women’s Day. Hua Chenyu sent special blessings to attending fans by SMS: “As spring blossoms, Fuzhou extends its invitation. On the occasion of International Women’s Day, may each unique soul among you become the wind, the ocean, and an eternal flame, forever growing towards the sun! - Hua Chenyu 2025.3.8” During the second day’s performance, immediately after singing “Arrival“, the lift stage malfunctioned. With parkour-like agility, Hua leapt down multiple platform levels consecutively, igniting frenzied cheers throughout the venue. » Fuzhou Concerts Photo Gallery « Changsha On March 22-23, Hua Chenyu returned to his debut city Changsha to hold Concerts for two consecutive days. A drone conducting high-speed aerial filming around and the stage crashed at a corner of the platform, with the entire incident broadcast live on the giant screen in first-person perspective. While singing the line “There is a letter, A letter for you from the future” in “Let’s Go and Watch the Sunrise“, Hua pulled out a letter from his chest. The stationery featured a simple sketch widely cherished among the fans: Hua and ET sharing a kiss at sunrise. During the second day’s concert, Hua made a weather-based bet with fans, rooted in his “Little Sun” legend (believed to bring sunshine to concert dates). Despite prior continuous rain, Changsha experienced unusually scorching weather during the concerts, followed by a sudden temperature drop the next day. Hua pledged that If the next concert in Xi’an also has clear skies, fans win—and he’ll grant one collective wish. » Changsha Concerts Photo Gallery « Xi’an April 5-6 (Qingming Festival holiday in China), Hua Chenyu held consecutive concerts in Xi’an, an ancient capital of 13 dynasties. On Day 1, Hua mentioned “keeping the performance more family-friendly” as his father and sister were in the audience, while teasing a “an outfit requiring prolonged mental preparation” for Day 2. Fans speculated wildly about its boldness, only to discover a full-body leopard print ensemble the next day. The most renowned historical site in Xi’an is the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor’s Terracotta Army. Staffs from a Terracotta Warriors-themed musical troupe watched the lives in Qin Shi Huang and warrior cosplay. During the performance of “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End“ they joined fans’ dancing in the arena pit. While filming a vlog at a snack street the day before, Hua passed by a fan girl without being recognized. At the concert, Hua publicly screened the coincidentally recorded encounter, jokingly awarding her an autographed “reunions feel distant” (from “In the Morning Light, There’s You“ lyrics) certificate, and gifted her a whole set of merchandise. Having lost the weather-based bet with fans (no rain occurred), Hua voluntarily proposed fulfilling the wager by dancing to choreography from his “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology“ MV - his first official concert dance performance. On Day 2, Hua executed the routine wearing Lop-eared rabbit shaped woolen hat, then turned completely red from shyness. » Xi'an Concerts Photo Gallery « Foshan China celebrated Labor Day from May 1 to 5, and Hua Chenyu held three consecutive Theme Park-style Concert from May 2 to 4 in Foshan. The third day (May 4) marked the first anniversary of the sunrise concert, and Hua prepared many surprises for the Martians. Hua Chenyu sent gift boxes by express delivery to audiences in the inner area (CN¥1280/980). The boxes included a small bottle of perfume, lipstick, a key-shaped ornament, and a plastic wristband. Hua Chenyu has twice posted photos on social media of himself cooking fried rice. Encouraged by enthusiastic Martians, he promised to treat everyone to his “Chenyu Fried Rice.” He shared his fried rice recipe and set up “Chenyu Fried Rice” booths, offering free portions to all (each person could line up multiple times to receive a 50ml cup-sized serving). At the concert, he mentioned that a total of 3 tons of rice were consumed over the three days. During the live broadcast on the day before the performance, Hua Chenyu fried rice at the stall on the spot. He originally wanted to distribute the fried rice to the fans who were watching outside the venue, but due to the large safety distance on both sides of the enclosure, he couldn’t hand it out and had to give up with regret. Various facilities in the concert were upgraded, including: Air-conditioned rest area in the VIP section (The large tent was enclosed with transparent plastic, allowing people to rest while still being able to watch the concert at the same time.) All areas provided free drinking water, ice, and anti-heatstroke medicine. Several high-end mobile toilets and changing rooms were set up, with an increased number of women’s restrooms, along with a variety of feminine products. After a brief heavy rain on the second day, when the lawn became muddy, buckets and water hoses were provided for washing feet. In the afternoon sessions of the concert, the usual game segment was replaced with an Airplane Chess featuring various obstacles, intentionally designed to make Hua receive “punishments.” He ended up doing many things he normally wouldn’t do, such as dancing, mimicking emojis, taking rapid selfies, and creating live drawing. In keeping with local traditions, a lion dance troupe was invited to perform in the plaza on the third day. On the first day of the concert, the weather was hot. On the second day, there was a brief heavy rain during the middle of the event. The game segment was skipped, and many pieces of equipment were damaged. Repairs caused a 20-minute delay to the evening session. During the rain, audiences were allowed to leave the venue to take a break, and re-entry was arranged once the rain had stopped. The heavy rain didn’t dampen the fans’ enthusiasm – many of them started playing in the rain, which eased Hua’s worries about everyone. During the evening session, he mentioned that he had seen various videos online of fans having fun in the water. On the third day, to celebrate the first anniversary of the sunrise concert, Hua had a custom cake made (see photo).Zuo Li prepared a custom banner (see photo), with the words: “This is a remarkable first anniversary of the sunrise concert!” The surprise of the evening show on the third day was that 2,000 drones were launched to simulate the sun and spell out the words: “You are my sun — by Big Brother. (你们就是我的太阳 ——大哥)”. It had been kept secret from the fans all the time. The drones could only be flown when the weather was fine at night. So, since the daytime, Hua had been particularly worried. He checked the sky several times and talked about various topics related to the sky. On the third day, just like during last year’s sunrise concert, over ten thousand fans who couldn’t get tickets gathered outside the venue to watch. Hua Chenyu greeted them through the big screen. During the “kiss” segment, he even asked the cameraman to come onstage and zoom in close, so that his face would appear more clearly on the big screen, making it easier for those watching from far outside the venue to see. » Foshan Concerts Photo Gallery « Qingdao On May 17, Hua Chenyu continued his live tour in Qingdao. Due to rain on the second day of the Foshan concerts, Hua won this “weather-based bet”. He proposed a fun trade-off for the Qingdao concert: he wanted to experience the same pleasure fans have—relaxing, eating, and even lying down while watching a concert! Consequently, at the following Qingdao concert, the fans performed a full sing-along of “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End“. This allowed Hua to relax on stage, enjoying local barbecue and beer. He even shared a toast with his band and downed a full glass of beer on the spot. » Qingdao Concert Photo Gallery « Chengdu From May 31 to June 1, coinciding with China’s traditional Dragon Boat Festival and International Children’s Day respectively, Hua Chenyu held two consecutive concerts in Chengdu. This year, the VJ for “The World is a Zoo“ features real-time rendering animation that randomly transforms the singer and audience into cartoon animal images, which is quite intriguing. For the Chengdu concerts, it was a panda-themed special edition, where everyone’s transformed image became a panda, and the background turned into a bamboo forest habitat scene. During the live stream the night before the concert, Hua accepted fans’ suggestions and challenged a high ponytail hairstyle for the second day’s performance. Additionally, since Hua announced the high ponytail during the first day’s concert, fans flocked to take overnight flights to attend! Tickets sold out completely that same day. During the performance, Hua, who noticed fans’ overnight travel updates on social media, kindly reminded everyone to rest and eat properly. Also during the live stream, Hua agreed to bring a camera on stage when the opportunity arises, allowing everyone to see his perspective from the stage. True to his word, after the performance, Hua released a first-person selfie video specially recorded during rehearsals, showing his entrance descending onto the stage from above. The second day of the performance coincided with International Children’s Day, and Hua invited visually impaired children to the concert through a charity organization. » Chengdu Concerts Photo Gallery « Zhengzhou On June 14, Hua Chenyu continued his live tour in Zhengzhou, Henan Province. Due to rain on the first day of the Chengdu concert, Hua won the “weather-based bet” again. His prize request was an a cappella chorus performed by the entire audience. He divided the tens of thousands of fans into three vocal sections based on their seating areas and taught each group a one-measure melody. By snapping his fingers and waving his arms to conduct the rhythm while singing the lead melody himself, he led the entire stadium in a collaborative a cappella rendition of “Mayfly“. Even in the subsequent “Kiss Song”, Hua divided fans into three vocal parts to chorus “mo-mo-da-“ (meaning “kiss” in Chinese). Hua created a brand-new intro music for “Ship of Theseus“, and the VJ animation for this intro music incorporated the creative concept of “Luoshan Shadow Puppetry” – an intangible cultural heritage. During the interlude of the performance, Hua performed Tai Chi to the music, a symbol of Chinese culture that originated in Henan Province. » Zhengzhou Concert Photo Gallery « Shenyang On June 28, Hua Chenyu held a concert in Shenyang, Liaoning Province, marking his first concert in China’s northeastern region. He admitted that coming to the Northeast made him want to tell jokes, even imitating famous sketches from the Spring Festival Gala on site and sharing several corny jokes. This was also the last tour concert of the first half of the year, with the next one resuming on August 29 – the day of China’s Qixi Festival (also known as Chinese Valentine’s Day). This schedule was mainly to avoid the intense summer heat, which Hua referred to as the “summer break.” The evening before the concert, Hua held a surprise livestream called “Martian Summer Break Class Meeting”, recounting memories from each concert of the first half of the year in turn. On the day of the concert, a fan couple got married and invited online all fans to attend, then go to the concert together that night. Learning about this via social media, Hua sang “We Meet When Flowers Fade“ with the audience at the venue as a blessing to the newlyweds. He also gifted them tickets to the next concert, inviting them to spend their first Valentine’s Day (Qixi Festival) as a married couple together. In the previous “weather-based bet” in Zhengzhou, it didn’t rain, so the fans won and Hua had to grant one of fans’ requests. Therefore, based on feedback seen in the live stream comments the night before, Hua accompanied the audience in chorusing “Warm House“. Since it was a last-minute decision, neither Hua nor the band had rehearsed it. There were parts where everyone sang wrong, and Hua even made mistakes while playing the piano. » Shenyang Concert Photo Gallery « Suzhou From August 29 to 31, Hua Chenyu kicked off the second half of his live tour in Suzhou. Since August 29 (Friday) is “Qixi Festival”, which is the Chinese Valentine’s Day based on the romantic legend of the Zhinü and Niulang, Hua specially arranged a concert on this non-weekend day. At the concert venue, the fences inside the stadium were elaborately decorated with 80,000 red roses, creating a dreamlike “Mars Rose Garden”. On the evening before Qixi Festival, Hua Chenyu specially held a live stream to interact with fans – he not only showed everyone the sea of roses at the venue but also took fans on a first-person view experience of the rehearsal for his aerial entrance during the opening song. This year, the Qixi Festival gift Hua prepared for the on-site audience was a limited-edition puzzle featuring the Mars flower bouquet pattern. Additionally, at the pop-up store, the annual Qixi Festival-limited red butterfly pastries (butterfly-shaped puff pastries) were launched. Hua Chenyu’s connection with Suzhou city dates back to several years ago, when he participated in the singing competition TV show “The Next (天籁之战)“ in Suzhou and commuted there every week. On this show, Hua fully demonstrated his songwriting ability and singing ability, and rearranged many songs that became massive hits. Once again, during the stadium performance, several sophisticated rocket-shaped fireworks were set off while “Eternal Flame“ was being performed. In the previous “weather-based bet” in Shenyang, Hua won again, and he shared another wish: “Actually, I have a small wish that I’ve kept hidden in my heart for more than ten years. Today, just in time for Qixi Valentine’s Day, I want to share this wish. My wish is that all Martians will be happy now and always in the future.” At the same time, Hua held up a carefully prepared “fan service board” (a board with messages for fans), which read, “Martians, strike a heart pose if you feel happy” and “How deep can love be?” Hua continued, “A few days ago, during a music festival in Qingdao, I was also singing ‘King and Beggar‘. Back then, I saw a fan – a little Martian – holding a board that said, ‘Hua Chenyu, strike a heart pose if you feel happy.’ So I struck a heart pose to her. Today, I want to say to all the Martians here: if you feel happy, can you strike a heart pose for me?” The fans responded one after another by striking heart poses. On the third day, it was drizzling. While singing “Arrival“, lightning flashed in the sky, which perfectly matched the stage’s light cascade, creating a unique sense of destiny. During the intro of the most thrilling song “Madhouse“, a huge bolt of lightning also lit up the sky. Hua Chenyu showed off his muscles on stage for the first time. Later, while changing clothes backstage, a colleague teased him, saying, “Bro, that was your first time showing off your muscles on stage, and it looked a bit clumsy.” This made him feel “a little shy – I originally wanted to look cool, but it turned out kind of clumsy.” » Suzhou Concerts Photo Gallery « Nanjing From October 4th to 6th, during China’s National Day and Mid-Autumn Festival long holiday, the rock theme park-style concerts were held for three consecutive days again after a major upgrade. Additionally, during the holidays before and after the concert (October 1st-3rd, October 7th-8th), the amusement area was open to all the public for free under the name of “Mars Utopia (火星乌托邦)”. On both sides and the back of the “Planet” stage, dozens-of-meters-long elevating extended stages were newly installed. As the stage design for “Ship of Theseus“, a huge inflatable wooden boat was newly placed as a real set in the center of the main stage. This inflatable boat was quickly set up and dismantled by the staff before and after the song performances. Based on previous years’ climate, temperatures drop after autumn in October, so measures like ginger tea were prepared. However, this autumn encountered an unusual heatwave; Hua Chenyu suffered from heatstroke due to the sun during the matinee and thus weared an ice vest again to cool himself down. Moreover, a large number of cooling pads were purchased and provided to the audience for free. The publicly open “Mars Utopia” included more games, food and beverage options, and art installations than the previous park-style concerts. During the three-day concerts, a drone-coordinated fireworks show was held every day, matching the songs “Eternal Flame“, “Bullfight“, “Warm House“, “Light Up the Bonfire at the Galaxy’s End“, as well as the final songs of the matinee and the evening Show, with a different design each day. Hua Chenyu himself stated that the cost of the three-day fireworks show exceeded the value of a villa. » Nanjing Concerts Photo Gallery « Haikou From November 28 to 30, 2025, the Mars Concert returned to Haikou Changying Wonderland, marking a comeback to the venue of its first Rock Theme Park-Style Concert held in 2021. The concert was originally scheduled to take place near Wenchang Spacecraft Launch Site in Wenchang City, Hainan Province. The aim was to allow the audience to witness the satellite launch by the modified Long March-7 carrier rocket on the evening of November 30 directly from the concert venue. However, due to various reasons, the ongoing stage construction was halted, and the concert had to change venues less than two weeks before the show. It was finally decided to be held at Haikou Changying Wonderland, which had experience hosting Rock Theme Park-Style Concert. The promotional poster also incorporates the elements of the 2021 Mars Concert poster. Prior to the venue change, Haikou Changying Wonderland, the host venue, took the initiative to promise that all audiences could enter the park for free and enjoy all amusement facilities throughout December by presenting their 2021 or 2025 concert tickets. The giant metal ring devices that resemble planetary orbits and surround the entire VIP area, a stage set that had accompanied the Mars Concert for a full three years, was retired after this Haikou concerts. A brand-new set will be used for the Rock Theme Park-Style Concert next year. The ring is affectionately nicknamed “环环 (Huanhuan, which means rings)” by fans, and Zuo Li specially presented Hua Chenyu with a custom plaque commemorating Huanhuan’s retirement during the Matinee on the third day. Inspired by a drum beat-matching game on TikTok, Hua Chenyu set up a drum beat-matching game themed after his song “Bizarre Psychology AKA Quirky Psychology“ in the amusement park. Unfortunately, both he and his band members all failed miserably at the game. He even tried to match the beat during his Evening Show, but failed two nights in a row; instead, the action of holding his head and squatting down after failing actually hit the beat. During the Evening Show on the third day, Hua Chenyu held a live streaming device and broadcast the first-person view of his aerial entrance on the large screen. This fulfilled the promise he had made to fans during a live stream before this year’s Suzhou concerts. Fireworks and drone shows were still featured in Haikou concerts. The drone show on the first day was themed around Mars Concert and roses, while the second day’s theme was Hua’s beloved cat Perper. On the third day, due to the drizzling rain that Hua jokingly called “moisturizing spray”, the drones were obscured by mist and hard for the audience to see. When leaving the stage, Hua Chenyu live-streamed on the large screen and showed the originally planned drone show renderings to the audience with a phone. During the Evening shows on the second and third days, Hua Chenyu took selfies with the audience’s phones at the end of the extended stage. Before the Matinee on the third day, Hua Chenyu went on stage early and took a full lap of selfies with a selfie stick. He later joked that this was to test the temperature and wind speed. At the end of Haikou concerts, Hua Chenyu officially announced that the 2.0 version of the Rock Theme Park-Style Concert would be launched next year, but the specific method needed to be kept confidential to prevent the idea from being plagiarized. He also shared the origin story of the 1.0 version of the concerts that started in 2021. He hopes to be regarded as just an ordinary Martian, and to eat, play, and enjoy ordinary joys with everyone in the Mars Utopia. » Haikou Concerts Photo Gallery « Nanning The Mars Concert Tour’s annual cycle is calculated according to the Chinese lunar calendar. Therefore, the Nanning concert on January 2, 2026, still falls under the 2025 tour schedule. The Shenzhen concerts from February 6 to 8 will be the final concerts of Mars Concert 2025. As a New Year’s gift, Hua Chenyu presented every audience with a cloth-made calendar themed around the “Charcoal ball (黑煤球)“. Hua Chenyu announced that the stage art design for this four-sided stage, which has been in use for three years, will come to an end this year. Next year, brand-new stage art design will be adopted not only for the Rock Theme Park-Style Concert, but also for the four-sided stages. » Nanning Concert Photo Gallery « Shenzhen From February 6–8, 2026, Hua Chenyu held the finale of his 2025 concert tour in Shenzhen. Among these dates, February 7th was his 36th birthday, marking his first-ever public birthday celebration since his debut. During the birthday concert on February 7th, fan-organized celebrations included: a collective sing-along of the “Happy Birthday” song following the “3-2-1” countdown of the “Kiss Song”; as Hua walked onto the extended stage, audience members in that section raised different colored fluorescent boards to form massive mosaic characters, while all spectators held up their own cake-shaped ornaments. The concert organizers arranged several tributes, including: distributing confetti popper to every audience member, featuring customized patterns and confetti shapes; a surprise appearance by a mascot in “Charcoal ball (黑煤球)” costume to present a birthday cake after the song “For Forever“, leading the fans in a synchronized birthday chant via the giant screens; and lighting up countless golden LED strips specially draped along the edges of the stadium stands. While performing the song “Conversations with Martian Children“, Hua finally couldn’t help but burst into tears, marking the first time he was too choked up to continue singing; the audience spontaneously took over, singing the entire second half of the song in a loud, powerful chorus. Throughout these three concerts, Hua several times stopped singing during unannounced segments and handed the mic to the audience; every time, the fans caught the lyrics and melody perfectly, leaving him both shocked and joyful. As this was the final stop of the 2025 tour, Hua announced that he had acquired three plots of land in Yunnan, which will be used to build the physical “Mars Home.” » Shenzhen Concerts Photo Gallery « 3. posts.title: Art Toy IP - Marsper
posts.text: Original Art Toy IP: Marsper AnecdotesBorn in 2020, Marsper is a personal original art toy IP deeply designed by Hua Chenyu. It belongs to the trendy art brand BORN TO LOVE, founded and spearheaded by Hua, and serves as the brand’s first officially released IP figure. “BORN TO LOVE” is both the core value and the slogan of Marsper. All of Marsper’s cross-sector collaborations are guided by this spirit. Marsper acts as the most representative “virtual ambassador” and artistic medium for its parent brand. The name Marsper combines “Mars” with “Per” (after Hua Chenyu’s pet cat, Perper), with the original intention of establishing a physical emotional connection with fans. As it was born in the Year of the Rat, its design features a cool rat figure wearing goggles and holding a heart. In September 2020, the pre-sale of the first collaborative model sold out instantly. Since then, it has continuously collaborated with Chinese and international artists such as Han Meilin and Yosuke Ueno, as well as fashion giants like Gucci and VOGUE, releasing multiple limited-edition series. By integrating NFC and blockchain technology to ensure collectibility, it has evolved into a representative art toy brand that merges music, art, and fashion. Since 2023, with the launch of the Rock Theme Park-Style Concerts, Marsper has evolved into a medium for interaction between virtual and reality. Beyond blind boxes and large-scale sculptures, it has become a core cultural symbol of the Mars Universe. AnecdotesNamed “Marsper” “I AM Marsper”I have a good friend named Perper.I have many family members from Mars.Per is a unit of measurement on Mars.It also represents that every family member is together.Mars is our common home.A haven from the world.Whenever my name is called,It felt like being with my family and friends.You are in me, and I am in you.It’s the coolest name for me.It is also the warmest name.IMarsper，From MarsBorn for love.future,Together,Forge ahead with determination. pages.title: Ticket Purchase Guide (For Overseas Fans)
pages.text: China Concert Ticket "Real Name System" Policy: Strict Identity Verification: The ticket purchaser’s information must EXACTLY MATCH his ID document (Chinese ID card/foreign passport) at both purchase and entry. Anti-Scalping: This system physically prevents resold tickets above face value at Mars Concert! Fraud Warning: Anyone claiming to sell tickets above official prices is a scammer. DO NOT ENGAGE to avoid losses. ‌Installation Install via Google Play Store or Apple Store Download and install the APK file: “Trip.com”, “大麦 (Damai)”, “猫眼 (Maoyan)” If you are a WeChat user, the WeChat Mini Program offers a more streamlined experience with built-in auto-translation functionality. Registration“Trip.com” app Support direct login with Google accounts, Apple accounts, Facebook accounts, and WeChat accounts. “大麦 (Damai)” app Requires Chinese (+86/+852/+853/+886) phone number Temporary numbers (rent online) are acceptable “猫眼 (Maoyan)” app Supports international phone number registration‌ ‌ Ticket Purchase‌ Typically 2-3 ticket sales rounds: Round 1: All tickets released Round 2: Resale of refunded tickets Round 3 (if applicable): Limited new seats added after stage setup “Trip.com” Fill in Attendee Information (must match the ID document) in the Account → Travellers & Contacts page in advance, and remove unnecessary saved info to avoid mis-clicks Ensure the number of pre-filled attendees matches ticket quantity Fill in Credit Card information in the Account → My Cards page in advance Search “Hua Chenyu Mars Concert“ on the homepage search bar, and enter the concert page from the search result Select correct date and price tier (recommended to click the “Add to calendar“ to set an alarm) and click “Remind me when it goes on sale“ Follow the countdown and click quickly at the last second to enter. Check details: ticket price, number of tickets, and attendee info. If correct, click “Proceed to Payment“ Choose a payment method (Credit Card, Alipay, WeChat Pay) and confirm it “大麦 (Damai)” & “猫眼 (Maoyan)” Search “华晨宇“ on the homepage search bar, and enter the concert page from the search result Click “预填信息 (Pre-fill Info)” to register attendee details (must match the ID document) Ensure the number of pre-filled attendees matches ticket quantity Select correct date/time, price tier, and quantity → Click “预约抢票 (Reserve Tickets)” When the countdown to the start of sales hits 0, spam the purchase button until payment page loads (which means the order was successfully placed) Payment Seat allocation prioritizes early payers → Complete payment ASAP! “Trip.com” Supports credit card (UnionPay, VISA, Master, AMEX, JCB, DISCOVER, ApplePay, Paypal…) “大麦 (Damai)” app Supports both Alipay and WeChat Pay “猫眼 (Maoyan)” app Only supports WeChat Pay Entry‌ Must use “人工通道 (Special Access Entrance)” (Automatic ticket gates only accept Chinese ID cards) Log in to purchaser account → Show QR code from “票夹 (My Tickets)” or “Trip.com App → Orders → Event Tickets“ Present original passport of the purchaser, while showing the QR code to the staff Refunds Full-order refunds only (multiple tickets in the same order must be refunded together) Free refund within 24hrs after initial sale 20-50% fee after 24hrs (increasing closer to event date, similar to airline policies) No refunds 10 days before the concert Force majeure exemptions: Contact customer service with valid proof (e.g., medical certificates) ‌ Summary & Tips Triple-check passport number & name accuracy in the Pre-fill Info Carry original passport (copies invalid) for entry Mobilize friends! Use multiple accounts across platforms to boost success rates

pages.text: Compile Hua Chenyu’s latest updates. 2026April “Game For Peace” Peace Elite League (PEL) FinalsOn April 26, 2026, at the final match of PEL 2026 Spring Season, Hua Chenyu attended as the celebrity endorsement and delivered the first offline performance of PEL’s new theme song, “Forever brave and young (千万次奔向)“.Hua Chenyu first kicked off the finals with a fiery performance of “Eternal Flame (永不熄灭的火焰)“. Later, during the halftime show, he performed “Iconic moment (名场面)“ and”Forever brave and young (千万次奔向)」” while cosplaying the “Vow of Time (时光之誓)” outfit paired with @花傲天 ‘s signature hairstyle. @花傲天 also made an appearance as a special birthday guest in the capacity of a PEL professional player, returning to the stage alongside other competitors.On the same day, Hua Chenyu announced his new role as an “Oasis Era (绿洲启元)” Developer. China Blue Zuili Lake Music FestivalA music festival hosted by Zhejiang STV on April 25, 2026. During the interactive segment following the performances, the host, representing Zhejiang STV, expressed their anticipation and extended an invitation to Hua Chenyu for more performance collaborations in the future.Just a few days prior, the MARS CONCERT 2026 scheduled to be the opening stop of “Mars Park-Style Concerts 2.0” at Fuxian Lake in Yuxi, Yunnan, during China’s May Day holiday, were abruptly cancelled due to force majeure. In the interactive segment, fans played a surprise video on the giant screen and sang “In the Morning Light, There’s You“ in unison to comfort Hua Chenyu. Hua, in turn, comforted the audience, sharing that on the very night the cancellation was announced, he had already organized a specialized task force to scout other Chinese cities for a suitable new venue. Kustie (Body care products)On April 24, 2026, Hua Chenyu was officially announced as the Global Brand Ambassador for Kustie, a Chinese body care brand. 火星演唱会 MARS CONCERT 2026 - Yuxi Concert CancelledThe performances scheduled for May 1-2 and 4-5, 2026, which were to serve as the opening stop for “Mars Park-Style Concerts 2.0” at Fuxian Lake (the second deepest freshwater lake in China) in Yuxi, Yunnan, were abruptly cancelled due to force majeure on April 22 – just one week before the event. Dismantling of the stage facilities, which cost over 2 billion JPY and were nearly complete, began that very night.According to media interviews and reports published before the cancellation, the decision to locate “Mars Park-Style Concerts 2.0” at Fuxian Lake was prompted by a warm invitation from Yuxi City. The event’s realization came only after navigating numerous challenges and setbacks.According to various estimates, the losses incurred by Hua Chenyu and the organizers from stage construction costs, hundreds of thousands of ticket refunds, VIP ticket perks and merchandise for sale, and compensation for flight and hotel cancellations alone will reach billions of JPY. This does not include investments in fixed assets such as local real estate purchases, infrastructure development, environmental protection support, and the establishment of supporting facilities.On the night the cancellation was announced, Hua Chenyu held a Livestream, performing several songs rearranged specifically for the concerts to comfort his fans. A few days later, at the China Blue Zuili Lake Music Festival, Hua Chenyu revealed that on the very night he learned of the cancellation, he had organized a specialized task force to scout other Chinese cities for a new venue and had already dispatched them to the field. “Forever brave and young (千万次奔向)“ On April 22, 2026, “Forever brave and young (千万次奔向)」”, the 7th-anniversary theme song of the mobile game “Game For Peace”, was officially released. Hua Chenyu participated in the vocal arrangement. March Skincare Brand “重点POINZ”As a co-founder, Hua Chenyu launched the skincare brand “重点POINZ”.The brand was co-founded by Xiaokuo Group (the parent company of the oral care brand Canban, for which Hua Chenyu serves as the ambassador) and Hua himself. This signifies that Hua Chenyu is no longer merely a brand ambassador; instead, he is deeply involved in every step of the brand’s chain, from product R&D to visual identity creation, in his capacity as a co-founder.With the core philosophy of “Smoothing out life’s little burrs”, POINZ is committed to pioneering a world of “Micro-care”, advocating a lifestyle that encourages people to “Focus on the essentials, and live a little more relaxed”. Its debut collection covers high-frequency daily essentials, including floral water, plant essential oil bracelets, cooling lithospermum soothing balm, hand cream, and lip balm.To celebrate the brand’s launch, a pop-up store opened in Hangzhou on March 22, 2026. That evening, Hua Chenyu made a surprise appearance at the venue to interact with fans and conduct a live stream. Zebra Music FestivalFor the first time at a music festival, Hua Chenyu performed his rock masterpiece “Seven Personalities (七重人格)“, along with “Beauty Yet Revealed to Me (那些我尚未知道的美丽)“ from his new album. 2026 Hunan TV Lantern Festival GalaHua Chenyu performed as the grand finale guest at the 2026 Hunan TV Lantern Festival Gala.Due to the freezing weather at the live broadcast site – with heavy snow even falling during rehearsals a few days prior – visible frost could be seen with every breath Hua took while singing. During the previous day’s rehearsal, Hua wore an exceptionally puffy bright yellow down jacket, which earned him the affectionate nickname “Honey Butter Bun” from the fans. February “China Daily” exclusive interview“Hua Chenyu: Music is Discovery, Not Creation“On the eve before his Shenzhen concerts, Hua Chenyuyu sat down for an exclusive interview with China Daily’s flagship column “The Sound of Excellence”. “I want to create a ‘Utopian’ space where everyone can feel as relaxed as they do at home,” he shared. 火星演唱会 MARS CONCERT 2025 - Shenzhen ConcertsFrom February 6–8, 2026, Hua Chenyu held the finale of his 2025 concert tour in Shenzhen. Among these dates, February 7th was his 36th birthday, marking his first-ever public birthday celebration since his debut.During the birthday concert on February 7th, fan-organized celebrations included: a collective sing-along of the “Happy Birthday” song following the “3-2-1” countdown of the “Kiss Song”; as Hua walked onto the extended stage, audience members in that section raised different colored fluorescent boards to form massive mosaic characters, while all spectators held up their own cake-shaped ornaments.The concert organizers arranged several tributes, including: distributing confetti popper to every audience member, featuring customized patterns and confetti shapes; a surprise appearance by a mascot in “Charcoal ball (黑煤球)” costume to present a birthday cake after the song “For Forever“, leading the fans in a synchronized birthday chant via the giant screens; and lighting up countless golden LED strips specially draped along the edges of the stadium stands.As this was the final stop of the 2025 tour, Hua announced that he had acquired three plots of land in Yunnan, which will be used to build the physical “Mars Home.” January Resident Judge for “Sound Trek (声鸣远扬) 2025”.Hua Chenyu has been invited to serve as a resident judge for the final stages (elimination rounds) of the singing competition “Sound Trek (声鸣远扬) 2025”. From November 9, 2025 to January 26, 2026, the program is broadcast live every Sunday at 7:30 PM across multiple TV stations and various apps, including YouTube. 火星演唱会 MARS CONCERT 2025 - Nanning ConcertThe Mars Concert Tour’s annual cycle is calculated according to the Chinese lunar calendar. Therefore, the Nanning concert on January 2, 2026, still falls under the 2025 tour schedule. The Shenzhen concerts from February 6 to 8 will be the final concerts of Mars Concert 2025.As a New Year’s gift, Hua Chenyu presented every audience with a cloth-made calendar themed around the “Charcoal ball (黑煤球)“.Hua Chenyu announced that the stage art design for this four-sided stage, which has been in use for three years, will come to an end this year. Next year, brand-new stage art design will be adopted not only for the Rock Theme Park-Style Concert, but also for the four-sided stages. “Ship of Theseus (忒修斯的船)”のMVThe 2D hand-drawn animation MV of the song “Ship of Theseus” was released on January 1, 2026. 2026 Hunan TV Countdown PartyHua Chenyu participated in Hunan TV’s countdown party for 13 consecutive years.This year, Hua first performed a solo medley of three of his signature tracks: “Great Sage Equal To Heaven“, “King and Beggar“ and “Growing Toward the Sun - Sunrise Ver.“. Among these, “Growing Toward the Sun - Sunrise Ver.“ featured middle school students in uniforms as backup dancers.
